confirmed.title: AI place suggestions from a previous survey are pre-filled into a re-scanned (possibly different) source directory
confirmed.summary: sortAiPlaces() captures no survey generation. Its response is applied to whatever `segInputs` currently holds, but sortScan()/renderSurvey() clears and rebuilds `segInputs` (line 557) and re-enables the AI button while the first /api/suggest request is still in flight (up to 180 s). A late response for source A therefore writes its `place` values into the segment inputs of source B keyed only by segment index.
confirmed.failure_scenario: User scans E:\DCIM, clicks 「AI 建议地点」 (claude -p runs ~60 s). While waiting, they change #sort-src to D:\Downloads\卡2 and press 「扫描并分段」: segInputs is rebuilt for the new survey. The old response arrives: for each s.index found in the new map, `t.place.value = s.place` is written into the D:\Downloads segments; the user clicks 「生成计划」 and the plan's event folders are named after the wrong trip. || 1) 整理页填 E:\DCIM 扫描得到 3 段，点「AI 建议地点」；2) 等待期间把源改成另一张卡再点扫描；3) AI 对旧扫描的回答到达：段 1 的 place 被填成旧卡的地点；4) 用户点「生成计划」→ 以错误地点生成事件夹名，执行后照片落进名字错误的事件夹。
confirmed.evidence: app.js:512-533 sortAiPlaces(): `const r = await post("/api/suggest", …); for (const s of j.segments || []) { const t = segInputs.get(s.index); … t.place.value = …; t.hint.textContent = "AI：" … }` — no stamp()/stale() check, unlike every loader in the file (gens/stamp/stale at 68-70, sortScan 543-548). app.js:557-558 renderSurvey: `segInputs.clear(); $("#btn-sort-ai").disabled = …`. busy() at app.js:648 is `vault.busy() || archive.busy()`; #btn-sort-scan / Enter handler (662, 664) not gated. ServeAi.hs:196-229 keys the response only by `index`. Contrast vault.js:184-209 suggest() via suggesting→busy().

verdict.reasoning: CODE: gui/ui/app.js:512-533 sortAiPlaces: reads `lastSurvey.src` at call time, awaits POST /api/suggest (server timeout 180 s, ServeAi/DESIGN-P8 §22.2), then `for (const s of j.segments||[]) { const t = segInputs.get(s.index); if (!t) continue; if (s.place && !t.place.value.trim()) t.place.value = …; t.hint.textContent = 'AI：' … }` — no stamp()/stale() generation check, unlike loadStatus/loadPlans/loadConfig/sortScan which all use the gens helper (app.js:68-70, 543-548). gui/ui/app.js:553-557 renderSurvey: `segInputs.clear(); $('#btn-sort-ai').disabled = !sv.segments.length;` then rebuilds inputs keyed by g.index (1..n) with empty place fields (app.js:568-583). busy() at app.js:648 is `vault.busy() || archive.busy()` and only gates nav/keys; `#btn-sort-scan` (662) and Enter on #sort-src (664) are ungated, and nothing disables them while the AI request is in flight (only #btn-sort-ai is disabled at 516). src/Pm/ServeAi.hs:196-229 re-runs surveySort on the request's src and keys the reply only by `index`. REPRO: 1) #sort-src = E:\DCIM, 扫描并分段 → 3 segments, segInputs {1,2,3}. 2) click AI 建议地点 → POST {kind:'place', src:'E:\\DCIM', gap:72}, claude runs ~60 s. 3) user sets #sort-src = D:\Downloads\卡2, presses 扫描并分段 → sortScan stamps 'sort', renderSurvey clears segInputs and creates new empty inputs for indices 1..k of the second card. 4) old response arrives: for index 1..3 present in the new map, `!t.place.value.trim()` is true → place.value = old-card place (e.g. 'Atlanta'), hint = 'AI：Atlanta（把握 high）'. 5) user clicks 生成计划 → makeSortPlan(sv.src=D:\Downloads\卡2, place='Atlanta') → plan folders named after the wrong trip. Nothing on screen says the suggestion came from a different scan. DESIGN: DESIGN-P8 §22.1 says AI only pre-fills and the user confirms, but REVIEW-LOG-4.md 簇 B (#5) makes '最新请求胜出' a class-level rule for every loader whose rendering depends on the current selection, and REVIEW-LOG.md F4 fixed the analogous in-flight problem on vault.js (`touched` set) — there is no ruling exempting the sort page. Not pinned by any test (GUI has no harness). Medium: wrong result on an edge path that requires the user to re-scan while a suggestion is in flight, but the outcome is a plausibly-named wrong event folder that the user must catch by eye.
verdict.corrected_summary: sortAiPlaces() captures no survey generation: if the user re-scans (possibly a different source) while POST /api/suggest is in flight, renderSurvey rebuilds segInputs and the late response writes place values keyed only by segment index into the new survey's empty inputs, so a different card's segments get pre-filled with the previous card's places and can be turned into wrongly named event folders.
verdict.suggested_fix: Capture `const gen = gens.sort` (or a dedicated stamp('sortAi')) and the survey object at the start of sortAiPlaces and after the await `if (stale('sort', gen) || lastSurvey !== survey) return;` before touching segInputs; alternatively disable #btn-sort-scan / ignore Enter while the AI request is pending.

confirmed.title: Settings page: saving an EMPTY drive-wait box silently writes driveWait=0 (disables drive-drop protection) instead of default
confirmed.summary: The '保存' handler for the backup drive-wait field sends `Number(val("#cfg-drive-wait"))`; for an empty input `Number("")` is 0, and server-side `checkPatch` accepts 0 because 0 is the documented value for '关闭瞬断保护'. The placeholder says '默认 1800 秒' (empty = default), but an empty save actually turns the protection OFF and persists `drive-wait = 0`; the response is 200 '✓ 已写入 …——已经生效'.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Open Settings while drive-wait is unset (field empty, placeholder "默认 1800 秒"). Click 保存 without typing. Request body {"driveWait":0}; checkPatch returns no error, configTxn writes drive-wait = 0, banner says success. From then on driveWaitFor gives noDriveWait (n <= 0 → off), so the next pm backup / pm apply on the flaky USB drive aborts on the first drop. || 用户没改内容直接点该行的「保存」（或把原值删空后点保存想恢复默认）→ 请求体 {"driveWait":0} → checkPatch 通过 → config.toml 写入 drive-wait = 0 → 之后 pm backup / doctor 遇到 USB 盘瞬断直接报错停止。 || Same construction on the workers field (app.js:685): empty box → `{"workers":0}` → 400 "并发数 0 越界（1..64）" — harmless but the error blames a value the user never typed.
confirmed.evidence: gui/ui/index.html:191 `<input id="cfg-drive-wait" type="number" min="0" max="86400" placeholder="默认 1800 秒">`; gui/ui/app.js:697 `cfgClick("#btn-cfg-drive-wait", () => saveConfig({ driveWait: Number(val("#cfg-drive-wait")) }));` where `val = (id) => $(id).value.trim()` (app.js:681); app.js:698 恢复默认 sends null; app.js:686-695 `valOrNull` used only for portfolioDir/vaultPush/portfolioPush. src/Pm/ConfigEdit.hs:118-132 FromJSON ConfigPatch maps a present number to `Just (Just d)`; ConfigEdit.hs:162-164 only rejects `d < 0 || d > 86400`; src/Pm/Removable.hs:88-91 `driveWaitSecs say n | n <= 0 = noDriveWait`; DESIGN-GUI.md:188 'null = 缺省 1800 s, 0 = 关闭瞬断保护'.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: gui/ui/index.html:191 `<input id="cfg-drive-wait" type="number" min="0" max="86400" placeholder="默认 1800 秒">` with buttons 保存 / 恢复默认. gui/ui/app.js:681 `const val = (id) => $(id).value.trim();` and :697 `cfgClick('#btn-cfg-drive-wait', () => saveConfig({ driveWait: Number(val('#cfg-drive-wait')) }));` — an empty (or non-numeric) number input has value '' and `Number('')` is 0. app.js:456 `cfgTxt('#cfg-drive-wait', bk.driveWait)` writes '' when the server sends null, so the box is empty whenever the setting is unset. Server: src/Pm/ConfigEdit.hs:118-132 FromJSON maps a present number to `Just (Just 0)`; checkPatch :162-164 only rejects `d < 0 || d > 86400`; applyPatch :185 `cfgDriveWait = maybe (cfgDriveWait c) id (cpDriveWait p)` → Just 0; src/Pm/Config.hs:259 renders `drive-wait = 0` under [backup]; src/Pm/Removable.hs:88-93 `driveWaitSecs say n | n <= 0 = noDriveWait`, `driveWaitFor cfg = driveWaitSecs (fromMaybe 1800 (cfgDriveWait cfg))`. REPRO: fresh config (no drive-wait) → Settings page shows empty box with placeholder 默认 1800 秒 → user clicks 保存 (e.g. after editing another field, or after clearing the box to 'go back to default') → POST /api/config {"driveWait":0} → checkPatch [] → configTxn writes `drive-wait = 0` → banner '✓ 已写入 …——已经生效'. Subsequent pm backup / pm apply / doctor use noDriveWait: a USB drop aborts immediately instead of waiting up to 1800 s. Reloading the page shows '0' (pm config prints '0（瞬断保护关闭）') but the success banner never says protection was disabled. Same construction at app.js:685 for workers: empty box → {"workers":0} → 400 '并发数 0 越界（1..64）' (harmless, wrong-blame message). DESIGN: DESIGN-GUI.md:188-189 defines null = 缺省 1800 s and 0 = 关闭瞬断保护 as distinct states; app.js:687-688 records the rule 'placeholder 写明「留空 = 默认」，因此空着点保存 = 清空（null）' and implements valOrNull for the three publish fields but not for drive-wait, whose placeholder makes the same promise. PublishTests.hs:323-326 pins only that the server accepts 0 and null; no test or doc says an empty GUI box should mean 0. Not a data-loss path (pm fails closed on drive drop) but it silently turns off a documented protection with a success message: medium.
verdict.corrected_summary: Settings page: the 保存 button for 掉线等待 sends `Number(val('#cfg-drive-wait'))`, so an empty box (the normal state when the setting is unset, placeholder '默认 1800 秒') submits driveWait:0, which the server legitimately accepts as '关闭瞬断保护' and persists as `drive-wait = 0`, disabling backup-drive drop protection while the banner reports success. The workers field has the same construction (empty → 0 → 400 blaming a value the user never typed).
verdict.suggested_fix: Use the existing valOrNull rule: `driveWait: (v => v === '' ? null : Number(v))(val('#cfg-drive-wait'))` and likewise `workers: v === '' ? null : Number(v)`; or refuse to save an empty box with a hint to use 恢复默认.

confirmed.title: Staging freshness gate compares a case-insensitive on-disk probe with a case-sensitive catalog filter: mismatched-case To-Be-Sync'd folder makes pm import/clean/sort refuse forever
confirmed.summary: stagingFresh slices the catalog with `take 1 (splitDirectories k) == [stagingTop]` (exact case), while freshnessSweep probes `root </> stagingTop` on disk (case-insensitive on NTFS) and re-keys every listed file under the literal `stagingTop`. If the staging directory on disk is spelled with different case, the catalog slice is empty while the disk listing is full, so every file counts as 'new' and `pm scan` can never reconcile it. Same exact-case comparison at Import.hs:96/157/192, Clean.hs:64, Diff.hs:60, contrary to DESIGN-COMMANDS §7.
confirmed.failure_scenario: User created the staging folder by hand as `to-be-sync'd`. After `pm scan`, catalog keys read `to-be-sync'd\Raw\26-08-X\a.ARW`. `pm sort E:\DCIM …`: stagingFresh → catStaging = ∅; freshnessSweep lists the same files → newN = N → Left '暂存区与索引不一致（新增 N …）→ 先 pm scan'; sort exits 2. Rescanning reproduces the same state, so sort, import and clean staging are permanently refused. || `pm import`: same gate; running pm scan changes nothing, while `pm status` reports '✓ 索引与磁盘一致' — contradictory, and the suggested fix never works.
confirmed.evidence: src/Pm/Cli.hs:470-477 `catStaging = Map.filterWithKey (\k _ -> take 1 (splitDirectories k) == [stagingTop]) (catEntries cat); q <- freshnessSweep root stagingTop catStaging`. Scan.hs:184-209 walks `root </> relPrefix` and keys with `uncoveredKey relPrefix rel = relPrefix </> rel` (:219-223); Scan.hs:239-250 sweepCounts `newN = Map.size (disk `Map.difference` catSlice)`. Catalog keys from Scan.hs:129 (listDirectory spelling). Import.hs:40 `stagingTop = "To-Be-Sync'd"`; Import.hs:157 `inArchiveLayer` exact-case vs Import.hs:105 foldPath. Win.hs probeName uses GetFileAttributesW (case-insensitive). Correct discipline nearby: Import.hs:139-140, Sort.hs judge `byFold`.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: Cli.hs:470-477 `catStaging = Map.filterWithKey (\k _ -> take 1 (splitDirectories k) == [stagingTop]) (catEntries cat); freshnessSweep root stagingTop catStaging` with `stagingTop = "To-Be-Sync'd"` (Import.hs:40) — exact String equality. Catalog keys come from Scan.hs:129 `relPath = if null rel then name else rel </> name` where `name` is from `listDirectory` (FindFirstFileW: on-disk spelling), so a folder created as `to-be-sync'd` yields keys `to-be-sync'd\…`. freshnessSweep (Scan.hs:184-209): `probeName base` = GetFileAttributesW (Win.hs:188-206, case-insensitive on NTFS) → NamePlain; `doesDirectoryExist`/`listTree` also resolve case-insensitively; every file is re-keyed `uncoveredKey relPrefix rel = relPrefix </> rel` (Scan.hs:219-223) = `To-Be-Sync'd\…`. sweepCounts (Scan.hs:239-250) `newN = Map.size (disk `Map.difference` catSlice)` with exact keys. The same exact-case first-component test is at Import.hs:69 (route), 96 (planImport), 192 (stagingArchivedSummary), Clean.hs:64-65, Diff.hs:60, Status.hs:281; nothing in pm ever creates the top-level staging dir with canonical spelling (grep: no createDirectory of stagingTop in init/Commands/Main; Sort only createDirectoryIfMissing under it, which on NTFS reuses the existing case-variant). REPRO: user's library has `D:\Photography\to-be-sync'd\Raw\26-08-X\{a.ARW,b.ARW}`. `pm scan` → catalog keys `to-be-sync'd\Raw\26-08-X\a.ARW`, `…\b.ARW`. `pm import`: Commands.hs:606 withFreshStagingCatalog → freshStagingCatalog (Cli.hs:521-529) → stagingFresh: catStaging = ∅ (first component `to-be-sync'd` ≠ `To-Be-Sync'd`); freshnessSweep lists 2 files keyed `To-Be-Sync'd\Raw\26-08-X\…`; newN=2, changedN=goneN=errN=0; freshPending=2 → Left "暂存区与索引不一致（新增 2 / 变更 0 / 消失 0 / 读取错误 0）→ 先 pm scan", exit 2. Running `pm scan` again produces identical keys, so the gate fails identically forever; `pm sort` (Sort.hs:557) and `pm clean staging` hit the same gate. Meanwhile `pm status` runs mainFresh with relPrefix "" (Cli.hs:487) and reports ✓ consistent, and stagingEventOf/planImport see zero staging entries (no '暂存区 N 个事件未归档', backup scope wrongly includes the staging files via Diff.hs:60). DESIGN: DESIGN-COMMANDS.md:31 and :164 state NTFS path identity is case-folded ("NTFS 按折大小写认路径身份", foldPath mj-2); DESIGN.md:44/144 mandate case-fold comparisons; CONTEXT lists case-folding mistakes as bugs. No doc or REVIEW-LOG entry declares the staging folder name case-exact, and no test pins exact-case behaviour. Edge path (only when the user's staging folder spelling differs), wrong result with an unfixable instruction → medium.
verdict.corrected_summary: stagingFresh (and the sibling staging predicates in Import/Clean/Diff/Status) identify the staging area by exact-case first path component `To-Be-Sync'd`, while the on-disk probe/walk in freshnessSweep is NTFS case-insensitive and re-keys files under the canonical spelling. If the user's staging folder is spelled with different case, the catalog slice is empty, every staged file counts as 'new', and pm import/sort/clean staging are refused with '→ 先 pm scan' although scanning can never reconcile it; status/backup-scope silently treat those files as non-staging.
verdict.suggested_fix: Introduce one predicate in Pm.Import, e.g. `isStagingRel rel = map (foldPath) (take 1 (splitDirectories rel)) == [foldPath stagingTop]`, and use it at Cli.hs:474, Import.hs:69/96/192, Clean.hs:64-65, Diff.hs:60, Status.hs:281. In stagingFresh, discover the on-disk spelling (listDirectory root, pick the name whose foldPath equals foldPath stagingTop, default stagingTop) and pass that name as relPrefix so sweep keys match catalog keys; alternatively fold both key sets before sweepCounts. Add a test with a lower-case staging dir.

confirmed.title: Config path (configFilePath) is only makeAbsolute'd, never canonicalized: junction/symlink/SUBST/8.3 components in %APPDATA% or PM_CONFIG make withConfigLock/writeConfig fail closed with an uncaught alias-attack error and a leftover .tmp wedges all later writes
confirmed.summary: `configFilePath` yields `getXdgDirectory XdgConfig "pm" </> "config.toml"` or `makeAbsolute PM_CONFIG`; neither resolves reparse points or 8.3 names. `withConfigLock` opens `fp <> ".lock"` via `openBoundTo` (handleIsAt), and `writeConfig` lands with `moveBoundNoReplace tmp fp` (rawBoundTo); deleteBoundAt performs the same check. All compare the handle's canonical path against the unresolved string and reject on any difference. The lock-open error is not isAlreadyInUseError so withConfigLock rethrows it: pm init / pm config set / pm backup init crash and POST /api/config returns 500. If the lock passes, writeConfig fails and leaves config.toml.tmp, wedging all later writes.
confirmed.failure_scenario: User profile relocated with a junction (C:\Users\zhe → E:\Users\zhe), or PM_CONFIG=D:\dotfiles\pm\config.toml where D:\dotfiles is a junction/SUBST, or an APPDATA containing an 8.3 component. `pm init --main …` → withConfigLock → openStateLock → handleIsAt compares \\?\E:\Users\zhe\… ≠ C:\Users\zhe\… → ioError '…打开后句柄绑定的不是这条路径…拒绝读写——人工核查' → rethrown → pm exits 1; reads keep working so pm runs but can never change or create its configuration, and the message blames a link attack. || Junction C:\Users\bob → D:\Users\bob: writeConfig → moveBoundNoReplace tmp fp → rawBoundTo mismatch → '句柄绑定的不是这条路径（打开前已被换成别名/链接），拒绝落位' → crash exit 1; subsequent `pm config set` / POST /api/config crash / 500. || `mklink /J …AppData\Roaming E:\Roaming`: `pm config set` → deleteBoundAt fp refused; second attempt: openFreshBinary sees tmp exists → deleteBoundAt tmp → same refusal; user told their config was hijacked. || Every configuration write fails with a message that claims the file was swapped for an alias.
confirmed.evidence: Config.hs:148-156 `configFilePath = do mo <- lookupEnv "PM_CONFIG"; case mo of Just p | not (null p) -> makeAbsolute p; _ -> do dir <- getXdgDirectory XdgConfig "pm"; pure (dir </> "config.toml")` (no canonicalizePath in Config.hs). Config.hs:314-328 withConfigLock: `r <- try (openStateLock (fp <> ".lock")); … | isAlreadyInUseError e -> pure Nothing | otherwise -> throwIO e`. Win.hs:446-455 openStateLock → openBoundTo; Win.hs:405-424 `ok <- handleIsAt h fp; … ioError (userError (fp <> ": 打开后句柄绑定的不是这条路径…"))`. Config.hs:288-301 writeConfig: `bracket (openFreshBinary tmp) …; when old (deleteBoundAt fp); moveBoundNoReplace tmp fp` (Win.hs:697/722 rawBoundTo-verified). Win.hs:538-545 openFreshBinary `when (lnk || ex) (deleteBoundAt fp)`; Win.hs:343-355 normPath strips only \\?\ and folds case. Config.hs:146-147 comment '首次失败残留的 .tmp 会卡死后续所有配置写'. DESIGN.md:578-583 item 4 asserts the fix; REVIEW-LOG-2.md:261-264 (round 32 R3). Callers: Commands.hs:137/195, ConfigEdit.hs:212/266, BackupCmd.hs:139/158, Serve.hs:281.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/Config.hs:148-156 `configFilePath` returns `getXdgDirectory XdgConfig "pm" </> "config.toml"` or `makeAbsolute p`; there is no canonicalizePath anywhere in Config.hs (grep confirms canonicalizePath only in Cli/GitGuard/Vault/BackupCmd/SortSource/ConfigEdit/Doctor). makeAbsolute = prependCurrentDirectory + normalise: it folds `/`→`\` and `..`, but never resolves junctions/symlinks/SUBST/8.3 names. withConfigLock (Config.hs:314-328) opens `fp <> ".lock"` via openStateLock → openBoundTo (Win.hs:405-424) → handleIsAt, which compares normPath(GetFinalPathNameByHandleW FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED|VOLUME_NAME_DOS, cbits/pm_win.c:25-30) with normPath(expected string); normPath (Win.hs:343-356) only strips `\\?\`, splits, lowercases. A junction/SUBST/8.3 component in the string therefore never equals the final path → ioError userError; withConfigLock only maps isAlreadyInUseError to Nothing and rethrows everything else. REPRO: `mklink /J C:\Users\zhe E:\Users\zhe` (profile relocated by junction; APPDATA=C:\Users\zhe\AppData\Roaming) or `set PM_CONFIG=D:\dotfiles\pm\config.toml` where D:\dotfiles is a junction. `pm init --main D:\Photography`: Commands.hs:123-131 preflight passes; :137 withConfigLock → openStateLock "C:\Users\zhe\AppData\Roaming\pm\config.toml.lock" → handle final path `\\?\E:\Users\zhe\AppData\Roaming\pm\config.toml.lock` → normPath ["e:\\","users",…] ≠ ["c:\\","users",…] → hClose + ioError "…打开后句柄绑定的不是这条路径（中途有别名…）拒绝读写——人工核查" → not isAlreadyInUseError → throwIO → app/Main.hs main has no handler → GHC prints `pm: …` exit 1. Same for `pm config set` (ConfigEdit.hs:266 withConfigLock, uncaught) and `pm backup init` (BackupCmd.hs:139); POST /api/config is wrapped in try (Serve.hs:281) → 500 "配置写入失败: …". Reads (BS.readFile by name, Config.hs:222) keep working so pm runs but can never create/change its configuration. Correction to the finder: the lock open always precedes writeConfig in all four write paths and sits in the same directory, so on such a setup writeConfig/deleteBoundAt/moveBoundNoReplace are never reached and no orphan config.toml.tmp is produced; the 'wedge' sub-claim is moot. DESIGN: DESIGN.md §14 item 4 (lines 578-583) states the handwritten normalisation multi-rejects and therefore 'path entry points must be normalised first', and names configFilePath's makeAbsolute as that normalisation; it lists 8.3/UNC/GUID/NFC as unhandled but does not register 'config directory reached through a junction' as a known limitation, and junction resolution is exactly what every other entry (resolveUnder canonicalizes base, BackupCmd.hs:59 canonicalizePath, GitGuard.hs:74) performs. README known limitations do not mention it. Round 32 R3 (REVIEW-LOG-2.md:260-264) only addressed slash/relative spelling. Tests cannot catch it: Spec.hs:54 sets PM_CONFIG under withSystemTempDirectory, which uses getCanonicalTemporaryDirectory (already canonical, long name). Edge configuration, no data loss, but a hard fail-closed lockout with an attack-shaped message → medium.
verdict.corrected_summary: configFilePath (Config.hs:148-156) only makeAbsolute's PM_CONFIG and never canonicalizes the XDG/APPDATA path. If any component of the config directory is a junction/symlink/SUBST/8.3 name, withConfigLock's openStateLock→openBoundTo→handleIsAt compares the unresolved string against GetFinalPathNameByHandle output, fails, and the non-EBUSY IOException is rethrown: pm init / pm config set / pm backup init die with exit 1 and a '句柄绑定的不是这条路径…人工核查' message, POST /api/config returns 500. Reads still work, so pm can never write its configuration on such a machine. (The lock fails before writeConfig, so no .tmp orphan/wedge occurs in this scenario.)
verdict.suggested_fix: In configFilePath, resolve the result once at the source: after makeAbsolute / the XDG join, apply canonicalizePath (directory ≥1.3.1 canonicalizes the longest existing prefix, so a not-yet-existing config.toml is fine), wrapped in try with the makeAbsolute'd path as fallback or a clear error. All lock/tmp/final names derive from fp, so they stay consistent.

confirmed.title: createRootInfo' feeds the raw, un-canonicalized root string (junction/SUBST/8.3/forward-slash vault.path) into handle-bound moveBoundNoReplace/deleteBoundAt; pm init / first vault push crash with an uncaught alias error and leak .pm/root-id.json.*.tmp
confirmed.summary: createRootInfo' builds `final = rootInfoPath root` and `tmp` from the caller's root string without resolveUnder/canonicalize (unlike every other .pm write), then calls moveBoundNoReplace and (on failure) an unguarded deleteBoundAt. rawBoundTo compares normPath of the expected string against GetFinalPathNameByHandleW output (resolves junctions/SUBST/short names); splitDirectories keeps the drive component with its own separator ("D:/" vs "D:\\"), so any root spelled with a forward slash (or 8.3, junction, SUBST) never matches. The rename is refused with '句柄绑定的不是这条路径（打开前已被换成别名/链接）'; the Left branch then calls `deleteBoundAt tmp`, which throws an uncaught IOException out of createRootInfo/runInit/ensureVaultRoot, leaving the .tmp behind. Callers with raw roots: Commands.hs:123 `makeAbsolute (ioMain o)` and Vault.hs:496 ensureVaultRoot passing cfgVaultPath straight from config.toml.
confirmed.failure_scenario: config.toml hand-edited to `[vault]\npath = 'D:/vault'`. First `pm vault push --category landscape X.jpg` (or GUI POST /api/vault/push-plan): createRootInfo' writes `D:/vault\.pm\root-id.json.<hex>.tmp`, then moveBoundNoReplace: normPath real = ["d:\\","vault",…] vs expected ["d:/","vault",…] → False → userError. try catches it, then `deleteBoundAt tmp` throws again, uncaught → CLI dies with a stack trace (exit 1), API returns warp's bare 500. confirmed.title: filterDirs collapses an unreadable year/event directory into 'not a directory' → silently omitted from the pm names report, exit 0
confirmed.summary: runNamesOn filters Raw\ and Raw\<year> listings with doesDirectoryExist, a two-state probe that returns False on ACL/attribute errors. Such a folder is dropped from both validYears and oddTop, so it is neither planned nor reported, and the command can end with '✓ 无可机械执行的改名' and exit 0.
confirmed.failure_scenario: <root>\Raw\2024 has an ACL that denies attribute reads. filterDirs: doesDirectoryExist "Raw\2024" → False → yearDirs = ["2023","2025"]; oddTop does not contain 2024 either. Output shows '命名: 已合规 N …' with no mention of 2024 and exit 0.
confirmed.evidence: src/Pm/Names.hs:243-245 `yearDirs <- filterDirs rawTop (sort years0); let (validYears, oddTop) = span' isYearName yearDirs`; :320-322 `filterDirs base ns = do flags <- mapM (\n -> doesDirectoryExist (base </> n)) ns; pure [n | (n, True) <- zip ns flags]`; :283. Compare Sort.hs:476 (whenPresent), Win.hs:218-226; REVIEW-LOG-4.md:127-134.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/Names.hs:320-322 `filterDirs base ns = do flags <- mapM (\n -> doesDirectoryExist (base </> n)) ns; pure [n | (n, True) <- zip ns flags]` is applied at :244 (year layer), :248 (event layer) and :252 (成片 layer). `directory`'s `doesDirectoryExist` is `(... <$> getFileMetadata path) `catchIOError` \_ -> pure False`, and on Windows `getFileMetadata` opens the object with CreateFile (FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS) — so an ACL deny(F) on a directory yields ACCESS_DENIED → False. The project verified exactly this: docs/REVIEW-LOG-3.md ~303 '目录级全拒 (F)：doesDirectoryExist 库层塌 Right False', docs/REVIEW-LOG-4.md:47-49 '目录级 deny(F) 实测走的是 NamePlain→doesDirectoryExist 塌 False 的「非目录」支', test/TestUtil.hs:78-87 (withDenyAll) and test/ScanGuardTests.hs:231-235 (base denied → old impl (0,0,0,0) fail-open). A False entry is dropped from `yearDirs`, so it lands in neither `validYears` nor `oddTop` (span' at :245 only partitions what filterDirs kept); there is no third bucket, no error, and the surrounding `try` (:242) only catches thrown IOExceptions, which never happen here because the denied directory is never listed. REPRO: root with Raw\2023 (all Scheme A), Raw\2024\RAW-2024-Summer-Boston (needs rename/decision), Raw\2025 (all Scheme A); `icacls Raw\2024 /deny <user>:(F)` (the project's own withDenyAll fixture); run `pm names`. :233 doesDirectoryExist rawTop → True; :243 listDirectory rawTop → ["2023","2024","2025"] (listing the parent is unaffected by the child's DACL); :244 filterDirs: doesDirectoryExist Raw\2024 → CreateFile ACCESS_DENIED → catchIOError → False → yearDirs = ["2023","2025"]; :245 validYears=["2023","2025"], oddTop=[]; :246-249 only 2023/2025 enumerated; namesPlan sees no 2024 entries; :283 prints '命名: 已合规 N · 待改名 0 · 待裁决 0 · 无法识别 0', :285 prints nothing for oddTop, :289-291 '✓ 无可机械执行的改名' and exit 0. The Scheme B folder in 2024 is neither planned nor reported. Same shape at the event layer (a denied event folder vanishes from the report) and at 成片 (:252): a denied 成片 event disappears from `restoreMonth`'s candidate list (:151-166), which can turn a two-candidate '歧义' NEEDS-DECISION into a unique — possibly wrong-month — rename. DESIGN: the comment right above the site (:238-241, round 35 F2) states the contract: '静默当空更糟（漏报待改名项）… 读不出 = 整批拒绝 exit 2，零计划', and docs/DESIGN-COMMANDS.md:182-183 '枚举本身整段 try：读不出 = 整批拒绝 exit 2、零计划'. P7-I R1 (docs/REVIEW-LOG-4.md:127-134) explicitly classed read-path `doesDirectoryExist` collapsing ProbeUnknown into '没有' as a defect and fixed Vault.listFlatPhotos / photosJsonRef / Sort.existingEvents / Plan.listPlans via `whenPresent` (src/Pm/Win.hs:218-233, src/Pm/Sort.hs:473-476); Names.filterDirs is the identical shape but was not in that list. The round-35 rule-09 inventory (docs/REVIEW-LOG-3.md:172-195) mentions only Names' 源根检查 (False→reject) and 目标占位判定 (downstream no-replace guard) — filterDirs was never inventoried or ruled acceptable. README 465-553 has no matching known limitation. No test pins the dropping behaviour. So the docs side with the finder: the code contradicts the documented '读不出 = exit 2' contract. Not refuted. Severity medium: edge path (requires an ACL deny on a library folder, but that is the project's own first-class injection scenario), wrong result (silent omission, exit 0) rather than data loss.
verdict.corrected_summary: In runNamesOn, filterDirs (Names.hs:320-322) uses the two-state `doesDirectoryExist` to classify each entry of Raw\, Raw\<year> and 成片. On Windows an ACL deny(F) on such a directory makes doesDirectoryExist return False (CreateFile ACCESS_DENIED swallowed by catchIOError — confirmed by the project's own ACL experiments in REVIEW-LOG-3/-4 and TestUtil.withDenyAll). The entry is then dropped from both validYears and oddTop, is never listed (so the enclosing `try` never fires), and is absent from the report: the header counts exclude it, no ⚠/✋ line names it, and the run can end with '✓ 无可机械执行的改名' and exit 0. This contradicts the documented contract at Names.hs:238-241 / DESIGN-COMMANDS.md §8 ('读不出 = 整批拒绝 exit 2、零计划') and is the same read-path fail-open shape that P7-I R1 fixed elsewhere via whenPresent but missed here. At the 成片 layer the omission can also remove one of two month candidates in restoreMonth, converting an ambiguity NEEDS-DECISION into a unique (possibly wrong-month) rename.
verdict.suggested_fix: Make the per-entry classification three-state inside the existing `try`: replace `doesDirectoryExist (base </> n)` in filterDirs with a helper that, when doesDirectoryExist is False, distinguishes 'really not a directory' from 'cannot determine' — e.g. use `probeName`/Win32 GetFileAttributesEx (which the project measured to be immune to deny(F)) and test FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY, treating ProbeUnknown or an attribute-read failure as `ioError (userError (path <> " 存在性查不出（ACL/介质错误？）"))` so it flows into the existing '枚举失败 … 未生成计划' exit-2 branch at :254-257. Alternatively wrap each entry in `whenPresent (base </> n) (doesDirectoryExist ...)` and raise on Left. Add a test using TestUtil.withDenyAll on Raw\<year> asserting exit 2 and that the year is named in the output. (Vault.listFlatPhotos:130 has the same per-entry shape and could be aligned in the same way, out of scope here.)

confirmed.title: planStale probes removable drive roots without SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS; pm plan list / prune / GET /api/plans can pop the system "请插入磁盘" dialog for an empty card-reader slot
confirmed.summary: `planStale` (sourceGone) calls `doesPathExist src` and `doesDirectoryExist (takeDrive src)` on the plan's absolute source path for every todo item. When the card is pulled from a reader the drive letter still exists but has no media; GetFileAttributes raises the Win32 hard-error box unless the process error mode has SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS. `suppressCriticalErrorDialogs` is only invoked inside `discoverBackupRoots`. `runPlanList`, `prunePlans` and `GET /api/plans` call `planStale` without it; under `pm ui` the request hangs until someone dismisses the box. PlanExecTests caseStale probes Z..H with doesDirectoryExist and uses a letter with no volume at all, so it does not cover the empty-slot case.
confirmed.failure_scenario: User imports from SD card H:, later removes the card but leaves the reader; the draft remains in .pm/plans. `pm plan list` (or the GUI plans page) → planStale → doesPathExist "H:\\DCIM\\x.ARW" → system dialog "There is no disk in the drive H:" blocks the process; GUI plans page never loads until dismissed. || User runs `pm sort E:\DCIM ...` (plan saved), pulls the SD card, then opens the GUI plans page or `pm plan list`: modal pops; each refresh re-pops the dialog.
confirmed.evidence: Plan.hs:389-392 `sourceGone op = do … ex <- doesPathExist src; vol <- doesDirectoryExist (takeDrive src); pure (not ex && vol)`; Plan.hs:444, :463 and Serve.hs:399 call sites; Backup.hs:41-45 the only caller of `suppressCriticalErrorDialogs`; app/Main.hs setupConsole (Win.hs:92-103) does not set the error mode. Win.hs:568-571/576-577 docs; DESIGN.md:601; DESIGN-COMMANDS.md:270; test/PlanExecTests.hs:157-159.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/Plan.hs:388-392 `sourceGone op = do let src = opSource (plRootPath p) op; r <- try (do ex <- doesPathExist src; vol <- doesDirectoryExist (takeDrive src); pure (not ex && vol))`. Both `directory` probes call GetFileAttributesExW (doesPathExist = getFileMetadata `catchIOError` False; doesDirectoryExist likewise). On a removable drive letter with no media Windows raises the hard-error handler (ERROR_NOT_READY) and shows the 「请插入磁盘」box unless the process error mode has SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS; only after dismissal does the call return the error → False. The project itself models this: src/Pm/Win.hs:568-571 `suppressCriticalErrorDialogs = () <$ c_SetErrorMode 0x0001` with comment "probing an empty card-reader slot must fail with an error code, not pop a system dialog", and DESIGN.md:601 / DESIGN-COMMANDS.md:270-271 list SetErrorMode as the countermeasure. The only caller is src/Pm/Backup.hs:44 inside `discoverBackupRoots`. Callers of `planStale` — `prunePlans` (Plan.hs:444), `runPlanList` (Plan.hs:463), Serve.hs:399 `GET /api/plans` — never call it; app/Main.hs:94 `setupConsole` (Win.hs:92-103) only sets encodings/console CP. No grep hit for SetErrorMode in gui/src-tauri/src/*.rs, so `pm serve` spawned by pm-ui.exe inherits an unmodified error mode as well. `try` catches IOException but the dialog is raised inside the Win32 call before any error is returned, so it cannot help. REPRO: config main=D:\Photography; H: is a multi-slot card reader whose card was removed after `pm sort H:\DCIM …` saved plan 20260920-101010-abc123 with items OpCopy "H:\\DCIM\\A7R00001.ARW" …, none executed. `pm plan list` → runPlanList → listPlans main → planStale p Nothing: peDone check skipped (mr Nothing), todo non-empty, allM sourceGone → src = "H:\\DCIM\\A7R00001.ARW" → doesPathExist → GetFileAttributesExW on an empty removable slot → system modal 「驱动器 H: 中没有磁盘」; process blocks until user clicks 取消; returns False; then doesDirectoryExist "H:\\" → second dialog; then vol=False → not stale (correct result, but only after two modal boxes). Same via GUI plans page: the warp handler thread blocks in the dialog, the page's fetch never resolves until it is dismissed; each refresh repeats it. DESIGN: docs say the volume-absent case (DESIGN-COMMANDS.md:581 "卷不在（相机卡拔了）不算") is handled and test/PlanExecTests.hs:157-159 pins only a letter with no volume (`filterM (not . doesDirectoryExist (c:":\\"))`), which never exercises an empty slot. No REVIEW-LOG entry rules the dialog acceptable for plan probing; DESIGN §14 line 601 treats the dialog as a risk to be suppressed. So code contradicts the documented contract; not refuted. Severity medium: edge path (empty reader slot), correct final answer, but a blocking modal that stalls CLI and the GUI plans page.
verdict.corrected_summary: planStale (Plan.hs:388-392) probes the plan's source path and its drive root with GetFileAttributesEx-based `doesPathExist`/`doesDirectoryExist` without the process ever having called `suppressCriticalErrorDialogs` (only `discoverBackupRoots` does, Backup.hs:44). When a plan's copy source sits on a removable drive letter whose media was removed (empty card-reader slot), `pm plan list`, `pm plan prune` and `GET /api/plans` (GUI plans page) trigger the Windows hard-error 「请插入磁盘」dialog (twice per plan) and block until it is dismissed; the eventual stale=False answer is right but the CLI/GUI request stalls on every refresh. The test only covers a letter with no volume, not an empty slot.
verdict.suggested_fix: Call `suppressCriticalErrorDialogs` once at process start (e.g. in app/Main.hs `main` right after `setupConsole`, or inside `setupConsole` in Win.hs), which is Microsoft's recommended practice and makes the existing call in discoverBackupRoots redundant but harmless; alternatively call it at the top of `planStale`. Optionally extend caseStale's comment to note the empty-slot case is covered by the process-wide error mode.

confirmed.title: Walk skips every reparse point via pathIsSymbolicLink, contradicting the project's own name-surrogate rule (OneDrive/Dedup placeholders become 'symlink skipped' errors)
confirmed.summary: listTreeCov decides 'is a link' with pathIsSymbolicLink, which on Windows is true for any FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT (cloud-file placeholders, Dedup, HSM). The project already ruled (P3b-12) that only name-surrogate reparse tags redirect; probeName implements that. The walk never got the same fix, so such files/dirs are dropped from indexing and sorting and each lands in the error table.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Sort source under OneDrive Files On-Demand: every photo carries IO_REPARSE_TAG_CLOUD* → sfPhotos is empty; `pm sort` prints 照片 0 个 and lists N 条 遍历时出错 'symlink/reparse point skipped'. Same for a library or backup root on a Dedup-enabled volume: pm scan indexes none of the deduplicated files, every scan exits 1, freshnessSweep counts them in errN so pm status / `pm backup` never report 一致.
confirmed.evidence: src/Pm/Scan.hs:134 `symRes <- try (pathIsSymbolicLink abs')`, :147-149 `if isSym then pure ([], [(relPath, reparseSkipNote)], [])`. src/Pm/Win.hs:196-205 probeName NamePlain unless name-surrogate bit; docs/REVIEW-LOG-1.md:126-127. Consumers: Scan.hs:262, :195, :258, SortSource.hs:74, Commands.hs:269.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: Scan.hs:134 `symRes <- try (pathIsSymbolicLink abs')` and :147-149 `if isSym then pure ([], [(relPath, reparseSkipNote)], [])`. `directory`'s Windows implementation derives SymbolicLink/DirectoryLink from `bhfiFileAttributes .&. FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT /= 0` — any reparse point (cloud-file placeholders IO_REPARSE_TAG_CLOUD*, Dedup 0x80000013, WOF/compact.exe /exe 0x80000017, WIM) is reported as a symlink. The project already ruled that only name-surrogate tags redirect: Win.hs:160-176 'Windows 上 OneDrive 云占位、Dedup、WIM-boot 等也是 reparse point，但它们不改变名字解析——一律拒绝会让 pm 在这类卷上整个不可用 … 判据改为 reparse tag 的 name-surrogate 位', implemented in probeName (Win.hs:190-206, `tag .&. 0x20000000`). REVIEW-LOG-1.md:126-127 and :270-271 record this as P3b-12's fix of a usability regression, HISTORY.md:68 likewise. The walk was never converted: rounds 37/38 (REVIEW-LOG-3.md:230-262) revisited all five pathIsSymbolicLink sites only for the 'exception collapses to False' shape, not for tag semantics. Consumers of the walk: scanRoot (Scan.hs:262) → catalog; freshnessSweep (:195) → status/backup/staging gates; SortSource.listSource (SortSource.hs:74) → sort. REPRO: main library (or `pm sort` source) on a Windows Server volume with Data Deduplication enabled, or a folder compressed with `compact /c /exe:lzx`, or a OneDrive Files-On-Demand sync root (all files there, hydrated or not, keep the CF reparse point). `pm scan`: for each file abs', pathIsSymbolicLink → Right True → isSym → `([], [(relPath, "symlink/reparse point skipped")], [])`; files = [] → statted = [] → entries = {} ∪ unknown(∅) → srCatalog empty, srErrors = N reparse notes → Commands.hs:269 exit 1; status/backup then see every photo as errors/new. `pm sort` from such a source: sfPhotos empty, N '遍历时出错' rows, hardErrors filters reparseSkipNote (Sort.hs / SortGuardTests.hs:72) so it exits 0 with '照片 0 个'. DESIGN: Scan.hs:47-51 and DESIGN-COMMANDS.md:62 call the skip '设计内', but the stated reason is junction/symlink redirection ('指回自身的 junction 会让递归无限下降，指向外部的会把源范围之外的照片纳入计划'), which is exactly the surrogate class probeName already isolates; no doc or README limitation says libraries on Dedup/OneDrive/WOF volumes are unsupported, and Win.hs explicitly says rejecting them is a regression. Tests pin only junction/symlink skipping (cannot create cloud/Dedup objects). Not a malicious race; Windows-only behaviour. Severity medium: wrong result (nothing indexed / nothing sorted) on an edge but realistic volume type; loud but misleading ('symlink skipped').
verdict.corrected_summary: listTreeCov decides 'is a link' with directory's pathIsSymbolicLink, which on Windows is true for any FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT object, so every file/dir carrying a non-name-surrogate reparse tag (OneDrive/cfapi placeholders incl. hydrated ones, Windows Dedup, WOF/`compact /exe`, WIM) is dropped from scan, freshness sweeps and sort with a 'symlink/reparse point skipped' error row. This contradicts the project's own P3b-12 ruling (Win.hs:160-176, REVIEW-LOG-1:126) that only name-surrogate tags redirect and that rejecting the rest makes pm unusable on such volumes; probeName implements the right test but the walk never adopted it.
verdict.suggested_fix: In listTreeCov replace the pathIsSymbolicLink probe with `probeName abs'`: NameSurrogate → reparseSkipNote (as today); ProbeUnknown → the existing '链接属性查不出' uncovered branch; NameMissing → fall through to the stat path; NamePlain → continue (dir/file). Decide separately whether dehydrated cloud placeholders should be hashed (hydration on read) or reported; update caseScanDeniedProbe, whose deny-all(F) fixture currently relies on pathIsSymbolicLink failing (GetFileAttributesW is ACL-immune, so the error would move to statSnap and lose the '查不出' wording).

confirmed.title: No exception boundary in serveApp / POST /api/apply / recordPost: IOExceptions from the execution chain escape to warp's bare 500 (no JSON, no CORS), so the GUI shows 'Failed to fetch' / '没有执行' although items may have landed
confirmed.summary: serveApp only attaches corsHdrs on err/jsonR responses; any IOException escaping a handler goes to warp's default onException: `500 text/plain "Something went wrong"` without Access-Control-Allow-Origin. The page is cross-origin (tauri.localhost → 127.0.0.1), so WebView2 rejects the response and fetch throws TypeError; r.ok/bodyReason never run. The apply handler calls prepareApply, executePlanNowWith and afterApply bare (ServeAlbum.planPost wraps in `try` precisely to avoid the empty 500); execPlanRetry rethrows deterministic IOExceptions, withRootLock/withJournal throw on untrusted/busy state files, and writeBackCatalog/afterApply's commit primitives throw after items have already landed and been journaled. ServeVault.recordPost (hold/notes) and the GET endpoints (/api/status, /api/config, /api/plans, vaultReport) have the same gap.
confirmed.failure_scenario: 计划页点击执行一份 import 计划；执行途中主库 .pm 被 ACL 拒写（PermissionDenied 属 Deterministic 族，原样抛出）→ 异常穿过 withMVar/withJsonBody 到 warp → 500 无 CORS 头 → fetch reject → app.js 显示「请求失败：Failed to fetch」、done=false 不刷新列表。用户看不到任何原因，也不知道前几项已 Done，自然会再点一次执行。 || A plan executes normally and then `writeBackCatalog` → `saveCatalog` throws (tmp refused by the trusted-write port, or the drive drops with drive-wait=0). Warp responds 500; the GUI banner says 没有执行 although the photos have moved. || Journal append fails (AV holding `.pm/journal.ndjson`, or `.pm/lock` replaced by a link → userError) → warp 500 → '请求失败：Failed to fetch'; the fail-closed reason is only on serve's stderr. || All copies land; saveCatalog → moveBoundNoReplace → sharing violation >20 retries → userError → 500 with non-JSON body → app.js '没有执行：HTTP 500'; user re-clicks 执行 or runs pm undo on a plan they think never ran. || A sync client holds `<main>/.pm/vault-holds.json` open when the user clicks 「保存决定并生成推送计划」: writeHolds → deleteBoundAt throws → propagates out of recordPost → warp 500; vault.js:236 shows 「决定未保存：HTTP 500 Something went wrong」 with no cause; orphan `vault-holds.json.tmp` left.
confirmed.evidence: Serve.hs:172-197 serveApp: `corsHdrs` only in `jsonR`/`err`; `| otherwise -> route env req jsonR err corsHdrs respond` without try/handle; `grep setOnException src/Pm/Serve*.hs` empty; Serve.hs:151-152 `runSettingsSocket defaultSettings`. Serve.hs:321-356 /api/apply: `withMVar (seApplyLock env) $ \_ -> do … prep <- prepareApply …; (code, results) <- executePlanNowWith cfg sink plan; afterApply cfg sink plan results; …` no `try` (compare Serve.hs:281 config endpoint; REVIEW-LOG.md:432 'planPost 无 try（空 500）'). Contrast ServeAlbum.hs:106-113 `-- …而不是 warp 的空 500 … r <- try (run …) :: IO (Either IOException …)`; ServeVault.hs:119-121 push-plan wraps savePlan. Throw sites: Removable.hs:137/161-173/206/249-254 (`Deterministic -> pure False` → `throwIO e`); REVIEW-LOG.md:599; Config.hs:643-660 withRootLock `ioError (userError (untrustedMsg …))` / `throwIO e`; Win.hs:405-418 openBoundTo/openStateLock; Cli.hs:158/273-286 writeBackCatalog; Catalog.hs:176-189; Win.hs:636-650 withDisposeHandle; Apply.hs:183-201 afterApply → Config.hs:706-724 writeSideCache; Config.hs:729-745 writePmState/writeJsonReplacing. ServeVault.hs:182-198 recordPost `withMVar (seVaultLock env) $ \_ -> do res <- withVaultTxn cfg reader $ \olds r -> do … w <- writer …` no try; VaultCmd.hs:60-75 withVaultTxn maps only Nothing. ServeGuard.hs:155-159 allowedOrigins; Serve.hs:28-30 cross-origin note. GUI: app.js:339-381 applyPlan `if (!r.ok) { out.textContent = "没有执行：" + (j.error || ("HTTP " + r.status)) }`, `catch (e) { … "请求失败：" + e.message }`, `if (!done) return;`.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/Serve.hs:172-197 serveApp builds `jsonR`/`err` with `corsHdrs` and then calls `route env req jsonR err corsHdrs respond` with no try/handle; runServe (Serve.hs:151) uses `runSettingsSocket defaultSettings`, and `grep setOnException src/Pm/Serve*.hs` is empty, so any exception escaping a handler is answered by warp's defaultOnExceptionResponse: `500 text/plain "Something went wrong"` with no Access-Control-Allow-Origin. The apply handler (Serve.hs:323-356) runs `prepareApply`, `executePlanNowWith` and `afterApply` bare inside `withMVar (seApplyLock env)`. The execution chain really rethrows: Cli.hs:145 `r <- execPlanRetry dw heal env plan` → Removable.hs:250-254 (`n >= dwAttempts dw -> throwIO e`; `recover` returns False for `Deterministic` at :137 → `throwIO e`); catalog write-back Cli.hs:150 `withDriveRetry dw root "索引回写" (writeBackCatalog …)` → Removable.hs:169/173 `throwIO e`; writeBackCatalog (Cli.hs:273-285) calls `withRootLock` (Config.hs:643-660 throws `userError` on untrusted `.pm/lock` and rethrows non-busy IOExceptions) and `saveCatalog`. The same shape exists for ServeVault.recordPost (ServeVault.hs:182-198: `writer` = writeHolds → writePmRecords (VaultHold.hs:146-153) → writePmState → writeJsonReplacing (Config.hs:737-745: openFreshBinary/deleteBoundAt/moveBoundNoReplace all throw) inside withVaultTxn with no try). The GUI is a plain cross-origin `fetch("http://127.0.0.1:"+port…)` (gui/ui/app.js:40; CSP connect-src http://127.0.0.1:* in gui/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json), so a 500 without ACAO is blocked by the browser and fetch rejects with TypeError. REPRO: plan with one pending Copy; user clicks 执行 → POST /api/apply → execPlan' lands item 1 (Intent+Done journaled) → withJournal closes → execPlanRetry returns Right → Cli.hs:150 writeBackCatalog → saveCatalog throws PermissionDenied (ACL on `.pm`) → judgeIO: PermissionDenied ∈ Deterministic (REVIEW-LOG.md:599) → recover False → throwIO → escapes executePlanNow' → apply handler has no try → withMVar releases → warp default 500 text/plain, no CORS → app.js:375 `catch (e)` shows「请求失败：Failed to fetch」, `done=false` so the list is not reloaded; the photo has actually landed and been journaled Done. If the exception is a userError from withRootLock/openBoundTo the same path yields「没有执行：HTTP 500」(app.js:346) when the response is not blocked (e.g. same-origin dev harness). DESIGN: the project itself treats warp's bare 500 as a defect and fixed it twice for sibling endpoints — Plan.hs:237-241 (listPlans, round 35: 'listDirectory 抛出，此前逃到 warp 的 500 兜底，GUI 拿不到结构化 errors') and ServeAlbum.hs:106-113 planPost (REVIEW-LOG.md:432 H: '`planPost` 无 try（空 500）'). DESIGN.md:603 registers kernel-level '执行期写口逃逸 = §6.4 进程死亡语义' as designed, but that is about the kernel, not about how serve renders it; nothing rules that /api/apply may answer an empty non-CORS 500. No test pins the exception path (test/ServeTests.hs:465-500 only covers 403/400/413/409). Not refuted; no data loss (journal has Intent/Done, re-apply is idempotent by content), so medium rather than high.
verdict.corrected_summary: POST /api/apply (and ServeVault.recordPost for hold/notes) run their write chains without `try`, unlike planPost/listPlans which were explicitly fixed for the same shape. Any IOException that the kernel deliberately rethrows (Deterministic errors from execPlanRetry/withDriveRetry, userError from withRootLock/openBoundTo, saveCatalog/writeJsonReplacing failures) escapes to warp's default `500 text/plain "Something went wrong"` without CORS headers. Because the Tauri page is cross-origin, fetch rejects and the GUI shows「请求失败：Failed to fetch」(or「没有执行：HTTP 500」) with no cause, even when items have already landed and been journaled Done; the reason is only on serve's (muted) stdout/stderr.
verdict.suggested_fix: Mirror ServeAlbum.planPost: in the apply handler wrap `prepareApply … executePlanNowWith … afterApply` in `try … :: IO (Either IOException …)`, read the accumulated `logRef`, and on Left answer `jsonR status500 [] (object ["error" .= ("执行中断: " <> show ex), "planId" .= pid, "log" .= logs])` so the GUI gets a JSON body with CORS headers and the lines printed so far; do the same around `withVaultTxn` in recordPost (Left → err status500 with show ex). Optionally add a last-resort `handle (\(e :: IOException) -> err status500 (show e))` around `route` in serveApp, but the per-endpoint try is the safer minimal change.

confirmed.title: existingEvents treats a regular file under Raw\ as a fatal enumeration error → whole `pm sort` survey exits 2
confirmed.summary: existingEvents lists `root\Raw` and then calls `lsDir` on every child name without checking that it is a directory. For a regular file probeName answers NamePlain, listDirectory throws, whenPresent turns that into Left, lsDir re-raises it, and the outer `try` converts it into `Left "已有事件夹枚举失败（被占/介质错误？）"`. surveySort returns Left, so `pm sort <src>` exits 2, GET /api/sort/survey answers 409 and POST /api/suggest fails. The R1 three-state rewrite introduced this regression; Pm.Names.runNamesOn handles the same enumeration via filterDirs. No test exercises existingEvents with a non-directory in Raw\.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Library has `D:\Photography\Raw\desktop.ini` (Explorer writes it when a folder icon/view is customised) or `Raw\Thumbs.db`. User runs `pm sort E:\DCIM` → output `已有事件夹枚举失败（被占/介质错误？）: …Raw\desktop.ini: …` and exit 2; the GUI sort page and AI place suggestion are unusable until the stray file is removed, and the message blames a media error/lock that does not exist. `pm names` on the same library runs fine. runSortPlanTo (which does not call existingEvents) still works, so the two forms disagree.
confirmed.evidence: Sort.hs:465-467 `a <- lsDir (root </> stagingTop </> "Raw")` / `b <- concat <$> (mapM (lsDir . ((root </> "Raw") </>)) =<< lsDir (root </> "Raw"))`; Sort.hs:476 `lsDir d = whenPresent d (listDirectory d) >>= either (ioError . userError) (pure . sort . fromMaybe [])`; Win.hs:188-206 probeName NamePlain for files; Win.hs:218-226 whenPresent; Sort.hs:467-471 outer try → Left → surveySort Left (Sort.hs:339/364) → runSortSurvey exit 2 (Sort.hs:406), Serve.hs:310-313 `Left m -> err status409 m`, ServeAi.hs:198. Contrast Names.hs:243-252/320-322 filterDirs. REVIEW-LOG-4 line 133.

verdict.reasoning:
CODE: src/Pm/Sort.hs:463-480. Line 467 `b <- concat <$> (mapM (lsDir . ((root </> "Raw") </>)) =<< lsDir (root </> "Raw"))` applies lsDir to EVERY child name of `<root>\Raw` with no directory filter. Line 476 `lsDir d = whenPresent d (listDirectory d) >>= either (ioError . userError) (pure . sort . fromMaybe [])`. Win.hs:188-206 probeName: a regular file has valid attributes and no FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT bit → NamePlain. Win.hs:218-226 whenPresent: NamePlain falls into the `_ ->` branch and runs `try (listDirectory d)`. The `directory` package on Windows implements listDirectory via getDirectoryContents → Win32.findFirstFile (path </> "*"); FindFirstFileW on `...\Raw\desktop.ini\*` fails (ERROR_DIRECTORY 267, 'The directory name is invalid') and Win32 raises an IOException. whenPresent turns that into `Left (p <> " 读取失败（...）")`, lsDir re-raises it as userError, the outer `try` at 465-471 catches it and returns `Left ("已有事件夹枚举失败（被占/介质错误？）: " <> show e)`. No caller guards against this: surveySort (Sort.hs:364-366) returns `Left e`; runSortSurvey (Sort.hs:406-410) prints it and returns 2; Serve.hs:310-312 answers 409; ServeAi.hs:198-200 answers 409. runSortPlanTo (form two) never calls existingEvents (only call site is Sort.hs:364), so `pm sort <src> --place ...` still works while the survey form does not. Contrast: Names.hs:243-252 + 320-322 filterDirs skips non-directories at the same `Raw\` level, and Vault.hs:130 listFlatPhotos (another R1 whenPresent conversion) explicitly partitions children with doesDirectoryExist — so a stray file in a layer directory is tolerated everywhere else in the codebase. The pre-R1 shape (doesDirectoryExist guard → [] for a file) did not have this failure; the R1 rewrite replaced 'is it a directory?' with 'does the name exist?', which is a different predicate.

REPRO: library `D:\Photography` with `Raw\2024\24-01-X-Raw\...` and a regular file `Raw\desktop.ini` (Explorer creates it when the folder icon is customised; Thumbs.db likewise). Run `pm sort E:\DCIM`. requireRole ok → withSourceQ lists the card → readTimes → existingEvents root: `a` (staging Raw) fine; `lsDir (root\Raw)` → ["2024","desktop.ini"]; mapM lsDir: "2024" fine, "desktop.ini": probeName → NamePlain → listDirectory throws → Left → ioError → outer try → Left "已有事件夹枚举失败（被占/介质错误？）: user error (D:\Photography\Raw\desktop.ini 读取失败（...invalid argument (The directory name is invalid.)）)" → surveySort Left → runSortSurvey prints it, exit 2. GET /api/sort/survey → 409 with the same text; POST /api/suggest → 409. `pm names` on the same library succeeds (filterDirs). Wrong outcome reached; the message tells the user to look for a lock/media error that does not exist.

DESIGN: REVIEW-LOG-3 (35th round F2, lines 29-33, 82-84) makes enumeration failure fatal for the case 'directory moved away / exclusively locked after the probe'; REVIEW-LOG-4 line 125-134 (R1) targets ProbeUnknown (ACL/media) collapsing into 'absent'. Neither round rules that a regular file sitting in `Raw\` should abort the survey, and DESIGN.md §3 line 23 describes Raw as `年份\事件夹` without stating that non-directory entries are forbidden. DESIGN-COMMANDS.md line 492 (sort exits 1 when a source subtree cannot be listed) concerns the source tree, not the library's Raw layer. No test in test/*.hs seeds a file directly under `Raw\` (SortTests stray fixture at 535 is a photo inside a staging event dir; ServeTests caseServeSortSurvey only checks the happy path). No README known-limitation covers it. Not a millisecond race, not OS-specific in the excluded sense (it is Windows behaviour). Finding stands.
verdict.corrected_summary: existingEvents (src/Pm/Sort.hs:467) calls lsDir on every child name of `<root>\Raw` without checking that the child is a directory. For a regular file (e.g. Explorer's `Raw\desktop.ini` or `Thumbs.db`) probeName answers NamePlain, whenPresent runs listDirectory on the file, which throws on Windows (FindFirstFileW on `file\*` fails), and the failure propagates as `Left "已有事件夹枚举失败（被占/介质错误？）..."`. Consequently `pm sort <src>` (survey form) exits 2, GET /api/sort/survey and POST /api/suggest answer 409, with a message blaming a lock/media error that does not exist, while `pm sort --place` (which never calls existingEvents) and `pm names` (which filters with filterDirs) work on the same library. Introduced by the R1 whenPresent rewrite, which replaced the previous 'is it a directory' guard with an 'does the name exist' probe; no doc or review round declares this intended and no test covers a non-directory in Raw\.
verdict.suggested_fix: In existingEvents, skip children of `<root>\Raw` that are positively identified as regular files before recursing, keeping fail-closed semantics for anything else, e.g. change line 467 to `b <- concat <$> (mapM (lsDir . ((root </> "Raw") </>)) =<< filterM (fmap not . doesFileExist . ((root </> "Raw") </>)) =<< lsDir (root </> "Raw"))` (import filterM / doesFileExist). doesFileExist returns True only when the name is definitely a file; a directory, an ACL-denied name or a missing name stays in the list and still goes through whenPresent's three-state probe, so the R1 ProbeUnknown→Left guarantee is preserved. Add a SortTests case that writes `Raw\desktop.ini` in the fixture library and asserts surveySort returns Right (and that the year-level event list is unaffected).

confirmed.title: rawEventOf treats a depth-3 Raw file's own name as its event folder, defeating criterion ③
confirmed.summary: `rawEventOf` matches `(a : b : c : _)`, so a file directly under `Raw\<year>\` is 'located' with the filename as the third segment instead of returning Nothing as the comment promises. The key becomes `Raw\<year>\<file>`, a JPG and its same-stem ARW get different 'event' keys, the `rawOriginals` lookup misses, and the Raw↔成片 same-sha pair is classified as designed redundancy and dropped from `vgExactDups`.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Catalog contains `Raw\2024\x.ARW` (S1), `Raw\2024\x.JPG` (S2) and `成片\24-05-X\x.JPG` (S2). `rawFinOk [r] [f]`: `rawEventOf r` = `Just "Raw\2024\x.JPG"`; `rawOriginals` holds `("Raw\2024\x.ARW", "x")` → lookup False → group deemed designed → NOT reported by `pm versions`. With `Raw\2024\ev\x.*` the same data IS reported.
confirmed.evidence: src/Pm/Versions.hs:143-147 comment '定位不到（层级不足）就返回 Nothing' vs `rawEventOf p = case splitDirectories p of (a : b : c : _) -> Just (joinPath [a, b, c]); _ -> Nothing`. Consumers :152-160 rawOriginals, :190-195 rawFinOk. test/NamesTests.hs:203-213 only depth-4 paths.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/Versions.hs:145-147 is exactly `rawEventOf p = case splitDirectories p of (a : b : c : _) -> Just (joinPath [a, b, c]); _ -> Nothing`. On Windows `System.FilePath.splitDirectories "Raw\\2024\\x.JPG"` = ["Raw","2024","x.JPG"] (3 segments), so the pattern matches and the file's own name is used as the 'event' segment; Nothing is only produced for depth <= 2. No guard elsewhere: `photos` (lines 111-117) admits every KindPhoto whose top segment is in archiveLayers regardless of depth, `rawOriginals` (152-160) and `rawFinOk` (190-195) both consume rawEventOf directly, and nothing in Scan/Catalog excludes files sitting directly in a year folder (test/KernelTests.hs:98 and test/PlannerTests.hs:332 even build catalogs with `Raw\2023\x.ARW`). REPRO: catalog = {Raw\2024\x.ARW sha S1, Raw\2024\x.JPG sha S2, 成片\24-05-X\x.JPG sha S2}. bySha[S2] = [Raw\2024\x.JPG, 成片\24-05-X\x.JPG]. rawOriginals = {("Raw\2024\x.ARW","x")} (ev for the ARW is its own path). designedGroup: raw=[Raw\2024\x.JPG], fin=[成片\...\x.JPG], alb=[]; counts ok, fin non-null; rawFinOk [r] [f]: baseOf r == baseOf f ("x.jpg") True; rawEventOf r = Just "Raw\2024\x.JPG"; Set.member ("Raw\2024\x.JPG","x") rawOriginals = False → not False = True; finAlbOk _ [] = True → designedGroup True → group filtered out of vgExactDups (line 136) → `pm versions` prints 0 真重复 and `pm dedupe` (which per docs/DESIGN-COMMANDS.md §8.1 uses the same vgExactDups) never offers it. With the same three files one level deeper (Raw\2024\ev\x.*) the key becomes ("Raw\2024\ev","x") for both and the group IS reported. DESIGN: docs/DESIGN-COMMANDS.md:186-188 and REVIEW-LOG-1B.md P4-9 define criterion ③ as 'Raw↔成片 同名且该 Raw 事件夹无同 stem 原始档; 有原始档＝导出件误放，仍报' — here a same-stem ARW sits in the very same folder, so the documented contract says report. The in-code comment (143-144) promises Nothing when the event folder cannot be located. Docs agree with the finder, not the code. No README known-limitation or review ruling covers files directly under Raw\<年>\. Tests (test/NamesTests.hs:203-213) only use depth >= 4 paths, so they do not pin the depth-3 behaviour. Severity medium: wrong result (under-reporting a misplaced export duplicate) on an off-layout edge path; no data loss since the direction is 'report less'.
verdict.corrected_summary: `rawEventOf` (src/Pm/Versions.hs:145-147) requires only 3 path segments, so for a photo lying directly in a year folder (`Raw\<年>\<file>`) it returns `Just "Raw\<年>\<file>"` — the file's own name as the 'event folder' — instead of the Nothing the comment promises. Because the key then differs per file, a same-stem RAW sitting right beside such a JPG is never found in `rawOriginals`, criterion ③ wrongly deems the Raw↔成片 same-sha pair designed redundancy, and it is dropped from `vgExactDups` (hidden from both `pm versions` and `pm dedupe`). Contradicts DESIGN-COMMANDS §5 criterion ③ ('有原始档＝导出件误放，仍报'). Only affects off-layout files at depth 3; no data-loss direction.
verdict.suggested_fix: Require the file to be at least one level below the event folder: `rawEventOf p = case splitDirectories p of (a : b : c : _ : _) -> Just (joinPath [a, b, c]); _ -> Nothing`. Depth-3 Raw files then yield Nothing → rawFinOk False → reported as noise, matching the comment's '宁可多报一行噪音'. Optionally add a test case in caseDesignedGroups with `Raw\2024\x.JPG` + `Raw\2024\x.ARW` + `成片\...\x.JPG` expecting the sha in vgExactDups.

confirmed.title: Q-DONE-LOST "--repair 不盲补" assertion is vacuous: fixture root has no root-id, so --repair is refused before applyRepairs runs
confirmed.summary: The test never calls writeRootInfo/mkPlanIO for `root`; it only creates `.pm/trash/<tpid>` and appends an Intent. `runDoctor root (DoctorOpts False True)` goes through `runDoctorGate` → `requireWritable root` → RootAbsent → Left → `diagnoseOnly`, and `applyRepairs` is never executed. The final assertion `filter isDone es @?= []` passes regardless of whether the repair whitelist honours severity.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Mutate Doctor.hs:661 `applyRepairs` to drop `&& fSeverity f == Warn`. On a real root, `pm doctor --repair` appends `JDone oid (Just intentSha) (Just trashRel)` for a quarantine whose trash payload holds different bytes — certifying wrong content as the quarantined original. The test still passes because in the fixture the repair pass is refused for lack of `.pm/root-id.json`.
confirmed.evidence: KernelTests.hs:544-556 no `writeRootInfo`. Doctor.hs:96-107 runDoctorGate. Config.hs:548-556 requireWritable Left for RootAbsent. Compare StateGuardTests caseDoctorTrashPayloadLink (285) and KernelTests C2/R2 repair tests via mkPlanIO→ensureTestRoot→createRootInfo.

On a real root with root-id.json, the Q-DONE-LOST Bad row (Doctor.hs:488, produced when `tsha /= sha`) has detail starting with `oid <> ":"` and fRow `Q-DONE-LOST`, so repairDone now includes it and `jAppend j Barrier (JDone oid (Just s) (quarTrashRel oid v) now)` is written (Doctor.hs:689-694) — wrong bytes certified as the quarantined original. Nothing in docs rules this a known limitation.
verdict.corrected_summary: test/KernelTests.hs:544-556 ("Q-DONE-LOST ... --repair 不盲补"): the fixture never creates .pm/root-id.json (only withJournal + trash dir), so `runDoctor root (DoctorOpts False True)` is refused at runDoctorGate → requireWritable → RootAbsent and falls to diagnoseOnly; applyRepairs never executes and the I11 Bad finding is discarded. The final assertion `filter isDone es @?= []` therefore passes regardless of whether applyRepairs honours the Warn-only whitelist (Doctor.hs:680). The first assertion (Bad classification when trash sha mismatches) is still meaningful; only the '--repair does not blindly append Done' half of the test is vacuous, and no other test pins that gate for Q-DONE-LOST.
