confirmed.title: Drive wait timeout exits 3 from inside run(), discarding all verification results and never writing --out
confirmed.summary: Drive.ensure() calls sys.exit(3) when the drive does not return within --drive-wait. It is invoked from inside run() after possibly hours of verification, so the ok/bad counters and the bad list are thrown away and finish() (the only place --out is written) never runs. The --max-drops path explicitly preserves progress for --retry but the timeout path silently bypasses it.
confirmed.failure_scenario: verify_backup_dst.py --plan X --root E:\... --out r.json runs 3 hours, finds 2 sha_bad entries, then the drive drops and does not come back for 31 minutes → 'GIVE UP' + exit 3; r.json is never written, the two sha_bad findings are lost, and the user must re-read every target from scratch because --retry has no input file.
confirmed.evidence: backup_verify.py:48-50 `while not self.ok(): if time.time() - t0 > self.wait_s: print(...); sys.exit(3)`; called from run() at :138 `if absent: drive.ensure()`; results only persisted in finish() :159-160. Contrast the STOP path :129-132.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: scripts/backup_verify.py:42-55 `Drive.ensure()` — `while not self.ok(): if time.time() - t0 > self.wait_s: print(... GIVE UP ...); sys.exit(3)`. It is called in three places: at startup in verify_backup_dst.py:22 and verify_backup_entries.py:20 (before any work, exit 3 is harmless there), and inside `run()` at backup_verify.py:137-138 `if absent: drive.ensure()`, which sits in the body of the `except (DriveGone, OSError)` handler (118-141). `SystemExit` is a BaseException raised from the handler body, so nothing in run() or the callers catches it; `finish()` (156-161), the only place `--out` is written (`json.dump(res, open(a.out, ...))` at 160), is never reached, and the locals ok/sha_bad/bad/... die with the frame. Contrast the sibling path at 129-132 (`drops > a.max_drops` → `queue.appendleft(t)`; `bad.extend(... 'not verified (stopped)' ...)`; `break`), which deliberately returns to finish() so --retry can resume, and the help text at :85 `--max-drops ... 超过就停、未读的记进 bad 供 --retry`. REPRO: `python verify_backup_dst.py --plan X --root E:\Photography --out r.json`, 500 copy targets. Targets 1-400 are read (2 sha_bad appended to `bad`). Reading target 401 raises OSError because the USB drive dropped; :121 sleep 2, :122 `absent = not drive.ok()` → True (root-id.json unreadable), :125 drops=1, :133 attempts=1 < 5 → :136 appendleft, :137-138 `drive.ensure()`. The drive stays unplugged for 31 min > 1800 s → :50 prints GIVE UP and `sys.exit(3)`. Process ends with exit 3; r.json does not exist; the 400 verified results and the 2 sha_bad findings exist only in scrollback (partial console progress lines every 50 items at :147-148); a later `--retry r.json` fails with FileNotFoundError at :93 and the user must re-read all 500 targets (tens of GiB) from scratch. Trace reaches the finder's outcome. DESIGN: docs/DESIGN.md:379-393, DESIGN-COMMANDS.md:304-305, README.md:465-553 (lines 42-51 of that block) and REVIEW-LOG.md:597/599 describe the scripts only as 'wait for the drive to come back and resume by themselves' / `--retry 续上次`; none documents that exhausting --drive-wait discards results or skips --out. The `ensure` docstring (:43) documents the exit code 3 but not the loss of progress, and the script's own --retry/--max-drops design (:82, :85, :129-132) shows the intent is to preserve progress for --retry on every give-up path. No test pins this (scripts have no tests). Not refuted. Severity low: read-only helper script, edge path (drive absent > 30 min), consequence is wasted re-read time and lost machine-readable findings, no data at risk.
verdict.corrected_summary: In scripts/backup_verify.py, `Drive.ensure()` (:42-55) calls `sys.exit(3)` on --drive-wait timeout. When invoked from the mid-run drop handler in `run()` (:137-138), the SystemExit skips `finish()`, so the ok/sha_bad/size_bad/missing counters and the `bad` list accumulated over the run are discarded and `--out` is never written — unlike the `--max-drops` STOP path (:129-132), which records the unread targets as bad and returns so `--retry` can resume. Users whose drive stays away longer than --drive-wait lose all verification progress and any sha_bad findings from that run and must re-read every target. Startup calls to `ensure()` in the two wrapper scripts are unaffected.
verdict.suggested_fix: Make the timeout path inside run() behave like the STOP path: e.g. add a `fatal=True` parameter to `Drive.ensure()` (or a distinct `DriveTimeout(Exception)`), keep `sys.exit(3)` for the startup calls, and in run() call `drive.ensure(fatal=False)` (or catch DriveTimeout); on timeout do `queue.appendleft(t)` (only if it was not already re-queued/recorded), `bad.extend({... 'why': 'not verified (drive did not return)'} for q in queue)`, `queue.clear()`, `break`, and set a flag in the returned dict (e.g. `res['gave_up'] = True`) so `finish()` writes `--out` and then exits 3 instead of 1 when the flag is set.

confirmed.title: leakscan.py crashes with an uncaught StopIteration when --extra is the last argument
confirmed.summary: The hand-rolled argv loop calls `next(it)` for the value after `--extra`; if `--extra` is the final argument, `next()` raises StopIteration, which propagates out of main() as an unhandled exception instead of a usage message. Because the exit code is 1 either way, a release-chain script cannot distinguish 'usage error' from 'leak found'.
confirmed.failure_scenario: `python scripts/leakscan.py pm.exe --extra` (value forgotten) → Traceback `StopIteration` at line 56; no scan is performed, exit code 1 — indistinguishable from a real leak hit in the release chain. || Scripted callers treat it as 'hit'.
confirmed.evidence: leakscan.py:53-58: `it = iter(argv); for a in it: if a == "--extra": extra.append(next(it)) else: files.append(a)` — `next(it)` has no default and no try/except; docstring line 4 documents `[--extra PAT ...]`. || README.md:448-449 'any hit exits 1'.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: scripts/leakscan.py:53-58 is exactly as quoted: `it = iter(argv); for a in it: if a == "--extra": extra.append(next(it)) else: files.append(a)`. `next(it)` has no default and no try/except. PEP 479 only converts StopIteration inside generator bodies; here `next()` is called in a plain loop body, so the StopIteration propagates out of main() and out of the module. There is no argument validation anywhere else in the file (no argparse, no usage check, no check that `files` is non-empty). REPRO (actually run in this container with python3): `python3 scripts/leakscan.py /etc/hostname --extra` -> `Traceback ... File scripts/leakscan.py, line 56, in main: extra.append(next(it)) StopIteration`, exit code 1, no scan output, no `patterns=... total hits=...` line. Control `python3 scripts/leakscan.py /etc/hostname` -> `clean`, exit 0. So the crash is real. CALLERS: .github/workflows/build.yml:114 and README.md:451 / README.zh.md:339 invoke the script with only file paths and never pass `--extra`; REVIEW-LOG.md:81 records that `--extra` / `PM_LEAK_PATTERNS` are for local use (the vault names must stay off the public repo). So the crash is reachable only from a hand-typed local invocation that forgets the pattern value, not from CI or the documented release command. DESIGN: README 465-553, DESIGN-P8.md:387/390, REVIEW-LOG.md:78-81/103/171 all describe leakscan only as 'any hit exits 1'; nothing documents 'missing --extra value crashes' as intended, and no test pins it (test/*.hs is Haskell and does not cover the script). Impact honestly: the exit code 1 is the fail-closed direction (a botched command cannot let a leaky binary pass), stdout carries no `total hits=` summary line and stderr shows a Python traceback, so a human operator will not confuse it with a hit; only a purely exit-code-driven wrapper would. Still, the docstring at line 4 advertises `[--extra PAT ...]` and the script has no usage path for a malformed invocation, so this is a genuine (low-severity, cosmetic/robustness) defect rather than intended behaviour.
verdict.corrected_summary: scripts/leakscan.py:56 calls `next(it)` with no default when parsing `--extra`; a trailing `--extra` with no value raises an uncaught StopIteration traceback (exit 1) instead of a usage message. Confirmed by running the script. Only reachable from a hand-typed local invocation (CI and the README release command never pass `--extra`), the exit code is fail-closed and the traceback/missing summary line make it visually distinct from a real hit, so the impact is limited to a confusing error and an exit code that a purely script-driven wrapper cannot tell apart from 'leak found'.
verdict.suggested_fix: Wrap the value read: `try: extra.append(next(it)) except StopIteration: sys.stderr.write("用法：" + __doc__.splitlines()[3] + "\n"); return 2` (or use `next(it, None)` and return 2 with a usage line when None). Optionally also return 2 when `files` is empty so a usage error is distinguishable from a hit (1) and clean (0).

confirmed.title: verify_backup_dst.py ignores plan item status: user-skipped copy items are demanded on disk and reported as missing / sha mismatch
confirmed.summary: Targets are built from every item whose op.t == "copy" regardless of the item's persisted "status" (pending / skipped / needs-decision). Plan files are rewritten with StSkippedByUser by `pm resolve --item N` and `--keep dst/src`. Those items were deliberately never executed, yet the script requires their dst to exist with the plan sha, so a correctly-resolved backup plan fails verification with misleading 'missing' or 'sha … != …' reasons.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Backup plan has a copy item whose dst already exists on the backup drive with different content. User runs `pm resolve <id> --item 7 --keep dst` → item 7 status {"s":"skipped"}. `verify_backup_dst.py --plan <id> --root E:\Photography` still verifies item 7 → sha_of(dst) != op.sha256 → RESULT sha_bad=1, exit 1. || Update group skipped via `pm resolve --item 7 --skip`, then `pm apply`. verify reports BAD {'why': 'missing'} and {'why': 'trash victims present 0/1'} and exits 1; a --retry re-reports the same forever. || 1000 copies and 2 supersede groups; skip one item; verify reports `missing` for it and `trash victims present 1/2`, exit 1 although every executed item verified.
confirmed.evidence: verify_backup_dst.py:24-25: `targets = [{"id": it["ix"], "path": it["op"]["dst"], ...} for it in plan["items"] if it["op"].get("t") == "copy"]` and :29-33 quarantine check — no reference to it["status"]. Plan JSON carries status per item (src/Pm/Plan.hs:66-69, 91-93; `toJSON StSkippedByUser = object ["s" .= "skipped"]`). Persisted skip paths: src/Pm/Apply.hs:253/263, 288-289, 327-329. Exec skips such items (src/Pm/Exec.hs:354/361-363 `ONotExecuted`). Apply.hs:112-131 loadPlanAnyRoot → backup plans resolvable. HISTORY.md:369.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: scripts/verify_backup_dst.py:24-25 builds targets from every item with op.t=="copy" and :29-30 counts every op.t=="quarantine" victim; neither reads it["status"]. The plan file does carry per-item status (src/Pm/Plan.hs:66-69 `toJSON StSkippedByUser = object ["s" .= "skipped"]`, :91-93 PlanItem ToJSON writes "status"). Plan files are never written back by execution (Plan.hs:315-317, 1.1.0 ruling), so a non-pending status can only come from `pm resolve`, i.e. a deliberate user decision. `pm resolve` reaches backup plans: Apply.hs:205 `loadPlanAnyRoot` falls through to `discoverBackupRoot` (:112-131), binds the root by UUID and `requireWritable`, then `resolveOn'` (:247-267) sets `StSkippedByUser` over the whole group closure and `savePlan`s to <backup>/.pm/plans/<id>.json. The default action of `pm resolve <id> --item N` is skip (app/Main.hs:452 `flag True False (long "unskip")`). Exec then returns `ONotExecuted` for such items (src/Pm/Exec.hs:353-354) — nothing is copied or quarantined. One correction to the finder: the `--keep dst` variant is NOT reachable on a backup plan — `kindBarrier "backup" = Nothing` (Plan.hs:309-312) so no exec-time demotion, Diff.hs/BackupCmd.hs create only StPending items, and resolveKeep refuses non-NEEDS-DECISION items and group members (Apply.hs:283-285). The `--item N` skip variant is fully reachable. REPRO: backup plan P has supersede group G = [ix 6 Quarantine victim X, ix 7 Copy dst X sha S_new]. User runs `pm resolve P --item 7` → group closure → items 6 and 7 get {"s":"skipped"}, plan rewritten on E:. `pm apply P` → both ONotExecuted; X keeps old bytes, .pm/trash/P/X never created. `python verify_backup_dst.py --plan P --root E:\Photography`: :25 includes ix 7; backup_verify.run :110 isfile true, :114-116 size (old size ≠ new) → bad {"why":"size …"} (or sha mismatch if same size); :29-33 present = N-1 → bad {"why":"trash victims present N-1/N"}; finish :161 exit 1. RESULT line shows size_bad/sha_bad=1 with nothing wrong on the media, and `--retry` (apply_retry keeps id 7) reports it again every time. DESIGN: README.md:198 / README.zh.md:144 / script docstring say "re-read every copy target of that plan"; no doc, REVIEW-LOG entry (593/597 only record all-pending runs 527/527) or README known-limitation addresses user-skipped items, so it is neither documented-intended nor ruled. No test pins it (no test references the scripts). Severity: the reported facts (dst ≠ plan sha, victim not in trash) are literally true for a skipped item, but the script presents them as a failed media check with exit 1 and a non-empty bad list that --retry never clears, on an undocumented edge workflow (manually skipping items in a backup plan) — a misleading result in a helper script, rated low.
verdict.corrected_summary: verify_backup_dst.py builds its copy targets and trash-victim list from every copy/quarantine item in the plan regardless of the persisted item status. Items a user skipped with `pm resolve <backup-plan-id> --item N` (status {"s":"skipped"}, group-expanded; the only way a backup plan gets a non-pending status, since backup plans have no barrier and never get NEEDS-DECISION, so the `--keep dst` variant is unreachable) are never executed by Exec (ONotExecuted), yet the script demands their dst with the plan sha and their victim in .pm/trash/<id>/, producing `size … != …` / `sha … != …` / `missing` and `trash victims present N-1/N` bad entries and exit 1 that look like media corruption and recur on every --retry.
verdict.suggested_fix: In scripts/verify_backup_dst.py restrict both comprehensions to items whose status is pending, e.g. `pend = [it for it in plan["items"] if it.get("status", {}).get("s", "pending") == "pending"]` and build `targets`/`quars` from `pend`; optionally print how many items were excluded as skipped/needs-decision so the count is visible.

confirmed.title: Trash-victim existence check runs with no drive-present guard; after a max-drops STOP it reports victims as absent
confirmed.summary: run() breaks out on `drops > max_drops` before calling drive.ensure(), so control returns to verify_backup_dst.py while the drive is typically still absent. The trash check then uses bare os.path.isfile on the absent drive, which answers False, collapsing 'cannot determine' into 'absent'.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Flaky drive exceeds --max-drops while the drive is offline → STOP; the script immediately checks .pm/trash/<pid>/<victim> for 12 quarantined files, all isfile()==False → prints 'TRASH victims present 0/12' and records it as bad.
confirmed.evidence: backup_verify.py:129-132 break happens before :137 `if absent: drive.ensure()`. verify_backup_dst.py:30 `present = sum(1 for it in quars if os.path.isfile(...))` with no drive.ok()/ensure() call. Contrast run() :110-112.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: backup_verify.run handles a read failure at :118-141: sleep 2 s, `absent = not drive.ok()` (:122), `drops += 1` if absent (:125), and at :129-132 if `drops > a.max_drops` it prints STOP, dumps the rest of the queue into bad as "not verified (stopped)" and `break`s — before reaching :137-138 `if absent: drive.ensure()`. So on the STOP path control returns to verify_backup_dst.py with the drive known-absent two seconds earlier. verify_backup_dst.py:29-30 then evaluates `os.path.isfile(os.path.join(a.root, ".pm", "trash", a.plan, victim))` for every quarantine item with no drive.ok()/drive.ensure() guard. os.path.isfile is a stat wrapper that returns False on any OSError (Python's genericpath.isfile catches OSError/ValueError and returns False), so an unmounted E:\ answers False for every victim — "cannot determine" collapses into "absent". Contrast run() :110-112, which re-checks drive.ok() before believing a missing file. REPRO: `--max-drops 40`, 12 quarantine items in plan; the 41st drop happens while the drive is offline: :122 absent=True, :125 drops=41, :129 41>40 → STOP, break. verify_backup_dst.py:30 → 12× isfile → False → prints `TRASH victims present 0/12`, :33 appends {"why":"trash victims present 0/12"} to bad; finish writes it to --out. The same misreport occurs for a drop that lands between the last read in run() and the trash loop, or mid-loop (partial count). Mitigations that bound the impact: exit code is already 1 because of the "not verified (stopped)" entries; the trash entry carries no "id" so apply_retry ignores it; a `--retry` run recomputes the trash check from the plan after drive.ensure() at :22, so the false line is corrected on the next run — it is a misleading line in stdout/result.json, not a lost or wrong verification that persists. DESIGN: docs/DESIGN.md:388-389 explicitly recognises this exact failure shape ("盘不在时 doesFileExist 答 False，会把掉线报成「消失」") for doctor --deep and requires 场末盘不在则整场作废重跑; nothing in DESIGN/REVIEW-LOG/README 465-553 declares the script's bare isfile probe intended, and the project's stated fail-closed philosophy says a probe must not collapse 'cannot determine' into 'absent'. No test covers the scripts. Not refuted; severity low (misleading message in a helper script, self-corrected by --retry).
verdict.corrected_summary: verify_backup_dst.py's trash-victim existence check (:29-33) uses bare os.path.isfile with no drive-present guard. After backup_verify.run() exits via the max-drops STOP branch (:129-132 breaks before the :137-138 drive.ensure()), or if the drive drops between/among the isfile calls, every victim reads as absent and the script prints/records 'trash victims present 0/N' as a bad finding. The exit code is already 1 on that path and a --retry redoes the trash check after drive.ensure(), so the effect is a misleading line in stdout and result.json rather than a persistent wrong verdict.
verdict.suggested_fix: In verify_backup_dst.py, before the trash loop call `drive.ensure()`; after computing `present`, if `not drive.ok()` record `{"why": "trash victims not verified (drive absent)"}` instead of the count (or re-run the loop once after ensure()). Optionally also in backup_verify.run add a `drive.ensure()`-free 'stopped while drive absent' note so callers know the state.

confirmed.title: import --also-album reports sidecars/meta files as '非 jpg → pm convert' (misleading suggestion)
confirmed.summary: withAlbumForImport passes every irCopy/irRework/irReworkKin entry whose dst is under 成片 to classifyAlbum without filtering enKind. arNotJpg lists .xmp/.acr sidecars and KindMeta files, and runImportTo prints `非 jpg 只进成片，不入相册: <path>（要进相册 → pm convert）`. pm convert rejects those, so the printed next step is wrong.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Staging has `To-Be-Sync'd\Processed\26-06-R66\a.jpg` and its sidecar `a.xmp`. `pm import --also-album` prints `· 非 jpg 只进成片，不入相册: …a.xmp（要进相册 → pm convert）`; `pm convert 成片/26-06-R66/a.xmp` exits 2 with `不是照片条目`/`不是转换对象`. Every sidecar adds one noise line.
confirmed.evidence: Album.hs:141-143 `toProcessed = [e | (e, d) <- irCopy rep <> irRework rep <> irReworkKin rep, isProcessed d]; arep = classifyAlbum cat toProcessed` (no enKind filter, unlike albumCandidates); Album.hs:95 `arNotJpg = [enPath e | e <- es, not (pushableExt (enPath e))]`; Commands.hs:531-532; Convert.hs:309/313 reject non-photo entries.

verdict.reasoning:
CODE: Pm.Import.planImport (src/Pm/Import.hs:98-102) takes every catalog entry under To-Be-Sync'd regardless of enKind; route (:71-72) maps `To-Be-Sync'd\Processed\\` to `成片\\` for any file, so sidecars (.xmp/.acr = KindSidecar, Types.hs:113-122) and KindMeta files land in irCopy with a 成片 dst. withAlbumForImport (Album.hs:141-143) filters only on `isProcessed d` and hands them all to classifyAlbum; arNotJpg (Album.hs:95) is `not (pushableExt ...)` with no kind/convertibleExt filter. runImportTo (src/Pm/Commands.hs:531-532) prints for each: `· 非 jpg 只进成片，不入相册:

（要进相册 → pm convert）`. runConvertTo (src/Pm/Convert.hs:309) rejects `enKind e /= KindPhoto` with `不是照片条目`, and (:313) rejects non-convertible extensions; RAW placed in Processed is likewise rejected (:312). REPRO: staging has `To-Be-Sync'd\Processed\26-06-R66\a.jpg` (sha h1) and `a.xmp` (sha h2), neither present in 成片. planImport → both in irCopy (dst 成片\26-06-R66\a.jpg / a.xmp). `pm import --also-album` → toProcessed = [a.jpg, a.xmp]; classifyAlbum → arCopy=[(a.jpg, 相册\a.jpg)], arNotJpg=[…a.xmp]. Output line: ` · 非 jpg 只进成片，不入相册: To-Be-Sync'd\Processed\26-06-R66\a.xmp（要进相册 → pm convert）`. Following it, `pm convert 成片/26-06-R66/a.xmp` (after apply+scan) → errs contains `成片\26-06-R66\a.xmp 不是照片条目` → exit 2. One noise line with a wrong next step per sidecar. DESIGN: DESIGN-P8 §19.2 (docs/DESIGN-P8.md:91-92) describes the message for `非 jpg 的成片（如 .tif）` i.e. non-jpg photos, and REVIEW-LOG C1 (docs/REVIEW-LOG.md:427) already ruled the analogous case (RAW listed as `非 jpg → pm convert` while convert rejects it) a defect and introduced convertibleExt for it; that fix was applied to albumCandidates only, not to this import path. Tests (AlbumTests caseImportAlbumPure :89, caseImportGroupE2E :283) use only .tif/.ARW fixtures and do not pin sidecar behaviour. The message is informational only and the follow-up command fails safely with a clear reason, so severity is low.
verdict.corrected_summary: `pm import --also-album` (and POST /api/import/plan alsoAlbum) reports every non-jpg staging file routed to 成片 — including .xmp/.acr sidecars, KindMeta files and RAW misplaced under Processed — as `非 jpg 只进成片，不入相册: … （要进相册 → pm convert）`, but `pm convert` rejects all of those (`不是照片条目` / RAW / `不是转换对象`). Only true convertibleExt photos (tif/png/psd/psb/heic) can follow the hint. Cosmetic/misleading line; no plan or data impact.
verdict.suggested_fix: In src/Pm/Commands.hs:531-532 append `（要进相册 → pm convert）` only when `convertibleExt p` (import Pm.VaultCore.convertibleExt), or in withAlbumForImport filter `toProcessed` to `enKind e == KindPhoto` and (for the hint) convertibleExt; existing tests (arNotJpg == [p3.tif], e2e `非 jpg 只进成片` for t.tif) remain green.

confirmed.title: albumCandidates mislabels a jpg lying directly under 成片\ (event = file name) and offers an un-addable / un-ignorable `pm album add <file>` command
confirmed.summary: `eventOf` takes the second path component as the event folder; for a KindPhoto jpg directly under `成片\` the second component is the file name itself, so the candidate is listed under a bogus event `[a.jpg]`. The CLI hint and the GUI `rel` field then produce an argument that `parseProcessedRel` (`length comps < 2`) rejects, so the listed candidate can never be added or ignored through the documented path.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Catalog contains `成片\stray.jpg`. `pm album candidates` prints `[stray.jpg]` as an event and `加入相册: pm album add stray.jpg …`; running that returns exit 2 `至少要 <事件夹>/<文件名> 两级`. In the GUI archive page the card's 忽略 button POSTs `{ignore:["stray.jpg"]}` → exit 2 → HTTP 400 `忽略清单未写入`; selecting the card and clicking add → exit 2. The candidate can never be cleared from the list. || User drops `成片\IMG_1.jpg` (no event folder), runs `pm scan` then `pm album candidates`: output lists `[IMG_1.jpg]` → `IMG_1.jpg` and suggests `pm album add IMG_1.jpg …`; running that gives exit 2. GUI 归档页 shows an event card titled with the file name.
confirmed.evidence: Album.hs:212 `eventOf e = case splitDirectories (enPath e) of (_ : ev : _) -> ev; _ -> ""`; Album.hs:201-209 filter only `top e == [processedTop]` (any depth); Album.hs:298-299 hint uses `joinPath (drop 1 (splitDirectories (enPath e)))`; Album.hs:172-177 parseProcessedRel `| length comps < 2 = Left (s <> "：至少要 <事件夹>/<文件名> 两级")`; ServeAlbum.hs:129 `"rel" .= joinPath (drop 1 …)`; gui/ui/archive.js:64 `ignoreCall({ ignore: [p.rel] }…)` and :163 planCall add-plan; Album.hs:226-227 / 399-400 both reject on perrs.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: albumCandidates (Album.hs:201-209) admits any KindPhoto jpg whose first component is 成片, with no depth requirement; eventOf (:212) takes the second component, which for `成片\stray.jpg` is the file name. runAlbumCandidates (:288-291, :298-299) prints `[<ev>]` and the hint `pm album add <joinPath (drop 1 comps)>`; ServeAlbum.candidatesJson (src/Pm/ServeAlbum.hs:126-131) emits `event` and `rel` the same way; gui/ui/archive.js:47/57 render the event header/card from `ev.event`, :64 POSTs `{ignore:[p.rel]}`, :69/:163 send `paths:[...picked]` with `p.rel`. parseProcessedRel (Album.hs:172-179): userRelOk "stray.jpg" = True (Op.hs:200-213), comps=["stray.jpg"], not a 成片 prefix, `length comps < 2` → Left `stray.jpg：至少要 <事件夹>/<文件名> 两级`; runAlbumAddTo (:227) and runAlbumIgnoreTo (:400) both return 2 on perrs; the ignore endpoint maps non-zero to 400 `忽略清单未写入` (ServeAlbum.hs:74). REPRO: user drops `成片\stray.jpg` (jpg, sha S, no album twin), `pm scan` (Scan walks the tree recursively, indexes it as KindPhoto). `pm album candidates` → cand=[(stray,False)], eventOf="stray.jpg" → prints `  [stray.jpg]` / `      stray.jpg` and `加入相册: pm album add stray.jpg …`. Running `pm album add stray.jpg` → exit 2 `✗ stray.jpg：至少要 <事件夹>/<文件名> 两级`. GUI: card under event header "stray.jpg"; 忽略 → 400 with that detail; selecting it plus a legit card → add-plan code 2, no plan (fail-closed whole batch). The candidate cannot be added or ignored through the documented paths; `pm album ignore` also rejects it. DESIGN: no doc, review ruling or test covers a jpg directly under 成片\; DESIGN-P8 §19.4 assumes `按事件夹分组`; pm itself never creates such a file (route requires `<event>/<rest>`, Import.hs:71). It is therefore an out-of-layout edge case created only by manual placement, and the consequence is a mislabelled read-only listing plus a hint/GUI action that fails with a clear, accurate error (no plan, no data effect). That is a misleading listing/hint rather than a wrong plan, so severity low rather than medium.
verdict.corrected_summary: A jpg placed directly under 成片\ (no event folder) is listed by `pm album candidates` / GET /api/album/candidates under a bogus event named after the file, and the offered `rel` (`stray.jpg`) is rejected by parseProcessedRel (`至少要 <事件夹>/<文件名> 两级`) in `pm album add`, `pm album ignore` and the GUI 忽略/add-plan actions (exit 2 / HTTP 400). The entry can only be cleared by moving the file into an event folder. Edge case outside the documented layout; no wrong plan or data effect.
verdict.suggested_fix: In albumCandidates, require the entry to sit inside an event folder (e.g. `length (splitDirectories (enPath e)) >= 3`) and either drop such files or surface them in a separate `不在事件夹下（先移入 <事件夹>\）` note in runAlbumCandidates/candidatesJson; keep eventOf/hint unchanged. Existing caseCandidates / ServeP8 fixtures all use event folders.

confirmed.title: Backup discovery collapses a present-but-corrupt/untrusted root-id.json into "drive not mounted, plug it in"
confirmed.summary: discoverAmong uses readRootInfo, which folds RootCorrupt and RootUntrusted into Nothing, so a mounted backup drive whose marker is damaged produces zero hits and discoverBackupRoot reports '备份盘未挂载 … → 插上备份盘后重试'. F018 removed this collapse from bindExecRootWith, but pm backup, pm clean staging and pickRoot --backup still go through the collapsing discovery.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Backup drive is mounted at E:\Photography; its .pm/root-id.json is truncated (or .pm replaced by a junction, or ACL denies reading it). `pm backup` prints '备份盘未挂载（在 3 个卷上都找不到 root …）→ 插上备份盘后重试' and exits 1. The user replugs, gets the same message; `pm apply <backup plan>` by contrast prints '备份盘 E:\Photography 身份损坏: …'.
confirmed.evidence: src/Pm/Backup.hs:32-37: `minfo <- readRootInfo c; pure [c | Just i <- [minfo], riRole i == RoleBackup, riId i == bid]`. src/Pm/Config.hs:552-558 readRootInfo: 'Present → Just；缺席、损坏与不可信都是 Nothing'. Backup.hs:59-64 message. Contrast src/Pm/Cli.hs:339-354 (bindExecRootWith, F018). Consumers: BackupCmd.hs:190, Apply.hs:74, Commands.hs:607.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/Backup.hs:32-37 discoverAmong calls readRootInfo, and src/Pm/Config.hs:552-558 readRootInfo maps RootCorrupt/RootUntrusted/RootAbsent all to Nothing. discoverBackupRoot (Backup.hs:59-64) then renders zero hits as '备份盘未挂载（在 N 个卷上都找不到 root …\.pm\root-id.json）→ 插上备份盘后重试'. Consumers: BackupCmd.hs:190 (pm backup, exit 1), Commands.hs:607 (pm clean staging), Commands.hs:453, Apply.hs:74/124, Cli.hs:362 (recheckCleanPlan), Cli.hs:312 (bindExecRootWith). I verified the absent-directory case is distinguishable: for a drive where <sub> does not exist, readRootState → requirePmTrusted → resolveUnder (Win.hs:478-503, canonicalizePath does not fail on missing paths; probeName '.pm' = NameMissing → Right ()) → readPmState (Config.hs:433-446, isDoesNotExistError → Right Nothing) → RootAbsent; whereas a truncated root-id.json gives RootCorrupt (eitherDecodeStrict' fails) and a junction/ACL-denied .pm gives RootUntrusted. So the information exists and is thrown away only in readRootInfo. REPRO: config has [backup] id='bk-1', subpath='Photography'; drives C: (no C:\Photography) and E: (E:\Photography\.pm\root-id.json contains '{'). pm backup → requireMain ok → discoverBackupRoot → discoverAmong 'bk-1' ['C:\Photography','E:\Photography'] → C: RootAbsent→Nothing, E: RootCorrupt→Nothing → hits=[] → Right (2,[]) → Left '备份盘未挂载（在 2 个卷上都找不到 root bk-1… 的 Photography\.pm\root-id.json）→ 插上备份盘后重试' → putStrLn, exit 1 (BackupCmd.hs:192). The file was found and is unparsable; the user is told to plug in the drive. One finder detail is wrong: pm apply does NOT print '备份盘 … 身份损坏' — bindExecRootWith (Cli.hs:312-315) also takes its backup slots from discoverBackupRoots, so a corrupt backup marker never enters `slots`; the F018 test (test/SweepTests.hs:294-304) only corrupts the MAIN slot. So apply reports '计划 rootId 与主库、vault、备份盘均不符' with no reason listed — a second manifestation of the same collapse, not a contrast. DESIGN: DESIGN.md §9 says only '找不到 → 提示插盘，绝不猜' (absent case); nothing documents corrupt/untrusted markers as 'not mounted'. The project's own stated rules go the other way: readPmState/readRootState three/four-state discipline (Config.hs:431-432, 519-530), workflow A cluster '查不出 ≠ 不存在' (Cli.hs:378, Commands.hs:446), and F018 itself (REVIEW-LOG-4.md:328) which ruled that a zero-candidate message must not claim a comparison that never happened. Removable.hs:100-103 explicitly chooses the collapse for driveOk, but that is a presence probe, not a user-facing diagnosis. Fail-closed decision (refuse) is preserved, so this is message-only: severity low.
verdict.corrected_summary: Backup-root discovery (discoverAmong/discoverBackupRoots) reads markers through readRootInfo, which folds RootCorrupt and RootUntrusted into Nothing, so a mounted backup drive whose .pm/root-id.json is damaged (or whose .pm is a junction/ACL-blocked) yields zero hits and every consumer (pm backup, pm clean staging, pm apply's bindExecRootWith, recheckCleanPlan, trash-empty three-copy check) reports '备份盘未挂载 … 插上备份盘后重试' or '均不符' instead of naming the corrupt/unreadable marker. Refusal is still fail-closed; only the diagnosis is wrong. (The finder's claim that pm apply already prints '身份损坏' for the backup slot is incorrect — F018 only covers main/vault slots because backup slots come from the same collapsing discovery.)
verdict.suggested_fix: Add a state-aware sibling in Pm.Backup (e.g. discoverAmongStates :: Text -> [FilePath] -> IO ([FilePath], [(FilePath, String)]) using readRootState, collecting RootCorrupt/RootUntrusted candidates with their reason while ignoring RootAbsent and role/id mismatches). Have discoverBackupRoots return those alongside hits, and in discoverBackupRoot's zero-hit branch append '；以下卷上的 root-id.json 存在但读不出/损坏: <path>: <why>' when the list is non-empty. bindExecRootWith can feed the same list into its `unreadable` slot list so F018's wording covers the backup slot too. Keep discoverAmong's existing signature for test/PlannerTests.hs:277.

confirmed.title: Backup discovery joins a hand-editable subpath with `</>`: an absolute subpath makes every drive 'match' and pm refuses with a bogus clone-conflict message
confirmed.summary: discoverBackupRoots computes candidate roots as `(c : ":\\") </> sub`. filepath's `</>` returns the right operand unchanged when it has a drive or leading separator, so an absolute `subpath` yields the same path for every drive letter, and a rooted one resolves against the current drive. cfgBackupSubpath is hand-editable and never validated by checkConfig.
confirmed.failure_scenario: User 'fixes' config.toml to `subpath = 'E:\\Photography'`. `pm backup`: drives C:, E: present → cands = ["E:\\Photography","E:\\Photography"] → discoverAmong finds the root-id twice → Left '多个卷同时匹配备份 root（E:\\Photography、E:\\Photography），身份冲突（同一标识被整盘克隆），拒绝…' → exit 1. With `subpath = '\\Photography'` the probe becomes `<cwd drive>:\\Photography` for every letter.
confirmed.evidence: Backup.hs:44-47: `hits <- discoverAmong bid [(c : ":\\") </> sub | (c, _) <- drives]`. Backup.hs:345-360 discoverBackupRoot multi-hit message. BackupCmd.hs:137-138 `let sub = snd (splitDrive abs')`. ConfigEdit.hs:57-80 checkConfig does not constrain subpath. Op.hs:188-206 relPathOk comment documents the `</>` semantics.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/Backup.hs:46 builds candidates as `(c : ":\\") </> sub`. filepath's Windows `combine a b | hasLeadingPathSeparator b || hasDrive b = b`, and on Windows `hasDrive "\\Photography"` is also True (a leading separator is a 'drive' in splitDrive), so any subpath that is absolute or rooted is returned unchanged for every drive letter. The project itself documents exactly this semantics for hand-editable fields at src/Pm/Op.hs:188-206 (relPathOk: '带盘符或以分隔符开头的第二参数是整体替换而非拼接') and Win.hs:484-488. The value pm writes is safe: BackupCmd.hs:137 `sub = snd (splitDrive abs')` with abs' guaranteed to be a lettered path by backupInitPreflight (BackupCmd.hs:51-58), so splitDrive 'E:\\Photography' = ('E:\\','Photography'). But cfgBackupSubpath is a plain TOML string (Config.hs:128) and nothing validates it: checkAbsolute (Config.hs:206-217) covers main/vault/photos-json/portfolio.dir only and is documented as '这里挡的是手编'; checkConfig (ConfigEdit.hs:57-80) only checks id/subpath pairing and nesting of discovered hits; loadConfig (Config.hs:200) only runs checkAbsolute. REPRO: user edits config.toml to `subpath = 'E:\\Photography'` (the Config.hs:106 comment says '盘符不入配置' but nothing enforces it). Drives C: and E: present, E:\\Photography\\.pm\\root-id.json is the genuine backup marker (role Backup, id = cfgBackupId). pm backup → discoverBackupRoots → cands = ['C:\\' </> 'E:\\Photography', 'E:\\' </> 'E:\\Photography'] = ['E:\\Photography','E:\\Photography'] → discoverAmong returns both → Right (2, [p,p]) → discoverBackupRoot line 65-69 → Left '多个卷同时匹配备份 root（E:\\Photography、E:\\Photography），身份冲突（同一标识被整盘克隆），拒绝——拔掉多余的盘或修正 root-id.json' → exit 1 (BackupCmd.hs:192). The advice (unplug a drive / fix root-id.json) is wrong; the real fix is the config. With `subpath = '\\Photography'` every candidate is the rooted path '\\Photography', resolved by Win32 against the process's current drive: cwd on E: → same multi-hit message; cwd on C: → '备份盘未挂载'. Same behaviour reaches checkConfig's bkNested probe, pm apply's bindExecRootWith, clean staging and trash empty. No unsafe outcome: UUID and role still have to match and every path is refused (fail-closed), so severity is low. DESIGN: no doc or REVIEW-LOG entry rules hand-edited subpath out of scope; README 465-553 has no such limitation; REVIEW-LOG-4.md:245 (cluster G6) explicitly made checkConfig the single sink for validating the whole config record including backup registration, which makes the missing subpath lexical check a gap by the project's own standard. Requires user misconfiguration, so impact is bounded, but the code path is real and the message actively misdirects.
verdict.corrected_summary: cfgBackupSubpath is joined onto each drive root with filepath's `</>`, which returns the right operand unchanged when it carries a drive letter or leading separator; pm itself always writes a drive-relative value, but a hand-edited absolute (`E:\Photography`) or rooted (`\Photography`) subpath is accepted by loadConfig/checkConfig and makes every present drive probe the same path, so a correctly-identified backup drive is refused with a bogus '多个卷同时匹配…整盘克隆' (or '未挂载') message that points the user at the wrong remedy. Fail-closed, no data risk; misleading message on a misconfiguration path.
verdict.suggested_fix: In Pm.ConfigEdit.checkConfig add a lexical check on cfgBackupSubpath: reject when `isAbsolute`, `hasDrive`, starts with a path separator, contains ':' or a '..'/'.' component (i.e. `not (null s) ==> relPathOk s`; allow the empty string since `snd (splitDrive "E:\\")` is "" for a drive-root mirror), with a message like '备份 subpath 须为盘内相对路径（如 Photography），不含盘符或前导分隔符 —— 重跑 pm backup init'. Optionally run the same predicate in loadConfig next to checkAbsolute so `pm backup`/`pm status` refuse before discovery.

confirmed.title: pm backup returns exit 1 ("差异/待处理") when the backup drive cannot be discovered, contradicting §5.1 (2 = error) and the F031 ruling
confirmed.summary: runBackupRun' maps discoverBackupRoot's Left to exit code 1, the code DESIGN §5.1 reserves for 'has differences / plan pending'. Every other error in the same function returns 2, and pickRoot SelBackup (F031) explicitly rules that an undiscoverable backup drive is a '2' error.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Script runs `pm backup --apply --yes` nightly and treats exit 1 as 'plan pending, look at output' and 2 as 'error, alert'. Drive is unplugged: pm prints '备份盘未挂载…' and exits 1; the alert never fires. Compare `pm undo --backup`/`pm doctor --backup` on the same condition: exit 2.
confirmed.evidence: src/Pm/BackupCmd.hs:190-192: `eroot <- discoverBackupRoot cfg; case eroot of Left msg -> putStrLn msg >> pure 1`. Adjacent branches 199/201/206/215 all `pure 2`. src/Pm/Apply.hs:73-79 F031 comment `Left msg -> pure (Left (msg, 2))`. docs/DESIGN.md §5.1. src/Pm/Cli.hs:181 planRunCode PrSaved = 1.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/BackupCmd.hs:190-192 `eroot <- discoverBackupRoot cfg; case eroot of Left msg -> putStrLn msg >> pure 1`. discoverBackupRoot (src/Pm/Backup.hs:53-67) returns Left for three states: backup not registered ("备份 root 未登记 → … pm backup init", Backup.hs:49), zero hits ("备份盘未挂载…", :57-62), and multiple hits / identity conflict (:63-67). All three are precondition failures; none is a diff, degradation warning, plan-pending or partial-conflict state. Every other early-exit in the same function returns 2: requireRole failure (:199), catalog unreadable (:201), identity changed after discovery (:206), mainFresh gate (:215). The only caller is app/Main.hs:144 (CLI); no serve/GUI/test consumer. REPRO: config with [backup] id/subpath registered, drive unplugged, run `pm backup --apply --yes` → requireMain passes → runBackupRun' → discoverBackupRoots enumerates drives, no root-id.json matches → Left "备份盘未挂载…" → exit 1, same code the command uses for PrSaved (Cli.hs:205) and for backupVerdict's incomplete-conclusion floor (BackupCmd.hs:279). With no [backup] registration at all the same branch also exits 1 for the literal "root 未 init" case. DESIGN: docs/DESIGN.md:264-265 §5.1 defines 1 = 有差异/降级告警/计划待处理/部分 conflict and 2 = 错误（路径不存在、root 未 init、IO 失败）; src/Pm/Apply.hs:76-79 (F031, REVIEW-LOG-4.md:215 cluster B) explicitly rules the same discoverBackupRoot Left as §5.1's 2 and pm undo/doctor/trash --backup return 2; DESIGN-COMMANDS.md:496 documents pm backup's other precondition (mainFresh) as 拒绝 exit 2; DESIGN-COMMANDS §9 (:272) only says 找不到 → 提示插盘 with no code. No doc, REVIEW-LOG ruling or test pins pm backup → 1 for this (test/GuardTests.hs:539 pins 1 only for runClean, a different command with a documented no-items outcome; ScanGuardTests.hs:123 notes discovery has no E2E test; git history is one squashed commit). The F031 comment's scope wording ("这条命令族") is the only thing that could be read as limiting the ruling, but the contract it cites (§5.1) is global and the finder's reading matches the docs, so not refuted.
verdict.corrected_summary: runBackupRun' (src/Pm/BackupCmd.hs:192) maps every discoverBackupRoot failure — backup not registered (literally 'root 未 init'), drive not mounted, and multi-volume identity conflict — to exit code 1, which DESIGN §5.1 reserves for 'has differences / degradation / plan pending'. §5.1 defines these as errors (2), Apply.hs's F031 comment explicitly classifies the identical Left as 2 for undo/doctor/trash --backup, and all sibling precondition failures in the same function exit 2. Within pm backup, 1 already means 'plan saved, not executed' or 'verdict incomplete', so a scripted caller cannot tell 'nothing ran, drive missing' from 'plan pending'. Message text is correct; only the code is wrong, so low severity.
verdict.suggested_fix: In src/Pm/BackupCmd.hs:192 change `Left msg -> putStrLn msg >> pure 1` to `pure 2` (optionally add a one-line comment citing F031 / DESIGN §5.1). No test or doc pins the current value; no other caller of runBackupRun exists.

confirmed.title: execPlanRetry heal reports '补记 Done N 条' even when doctor --repair degraded to diagnose-only (lock busy / not writable), and a landed rename is then re-run as CONFLICT
confirmed.summary: `heal` calls `runDoctorWith dw root (DoctorOpts False True)` and prints the number of C2/R2/Q-DONE-LOST Warn findings as the number of Done entries appended. But runDoctorGate silently degrades to `diagnoseOnly` when withRootLock returns Nothing or requireWritable fails; those rows are still Warn, so heal claims N repairs that never happened. Removable.settle's byJournal path then finds no Done and re-runs; for OpRename the kernel answers `OConflict "重命名源不存在"` for a rename that already landed.
confirmed.failure_scenario: `pm names --apply --yes` on the main root; item 2 renames Raw\2026\old -> new; moveBoundNoReplace succeeds, then `jAppend j Barrier (JDone ...)` throws an IOException. execPlanRetry: Hiccup -> sleeps 5 s -> heal. In that window the GUI's serve took the main root lock and still holds it: runDoctorGate -> withRootLock -> Nothing -> diagnoseOnly. Output: '· 自愈：pm doctor --repair 补记 Done 1 条' although the journal still has only the Intent. settle leaves item 2 unsettled, execPlan re-runs it, execRename' sees old missing -> 'CONFLICT: 重命名源不存在', exit 1, catalog keeps the old prefix.
confirmed.evidence: Cli.hs:149-151 heal counts `fRow f `elem` ["C2", "R2", "Q-DONE-LOST"], fSeverity f == Warn`. Doctor.hs:97-113 runDoctorGate → diagnoseOnly (I10/I11 Bad row) re-running `runDoctor'` with doRepair=False; classifyPending' R2 Warn regardless of repair. Removable.hs:250-261, 287-295 byJournal `_ -> pure Nothing`; lastDone deletes on JIntent. Exec.hs:595-596 `OConflict "重命名源不存在"`. Lock holders in the same GUI session: ServeVault.recordPost → withVaultTxn; ServeAlbum POST /api/convert/plan → Convert.runConvertTo withRootLock.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/Cli.hs:149-151 `heal = do (fs,_) <- runDoctorWith dw root (DoctorOpts False True); sink (printf "· 自愈：pm doctor --repair 补记 Done %d 条" (length [() | f <- fs, fRow f `elem` ["C2","R2","Q-DONE-LOST"], fSeverity f == Warn]))`. DoctorOpts is {doDeep, doRepair} (Doctor.hs:46-49), so this is a repair run. Doctor.hs:97-113 runDoctorGate: on `requireWritable` Left or `withRootLock` Nothing it calls `diagnoseOnly`, which re-runs `runDoctor' … opts{doRepair=False}` and appends one I11/I10 Bad row; the C2/R2/Q-DONE-LOST rows are produced by classifyPending' independently of doRepair (Doctor.hs:408, 461, 487 — R2 Warn text is literally "--repair 将补记 Done"), and applyRepairs (Doctor.hs:672-690) is only reached when the lock was taken. heal never looks at the I10/I11 row, so it prints the Warn count as "补记 Done N 条" even though zero JDone lines were appended. Removable.hs:250-261: after heal, `lastDone` (299-305) deletes the oid on JIntent, so `byJournal` (287-295) returns Nothing and the group goes back into `todo'`. The kernel has crash-recovery branches only for Copy (dst same content → SKIP) and Quarantine (Exec.hs:650-665); execRename' (Exec.hs:595-596) answers `OConflict "重命名源不存在"` when old is gone. REPRO: `pm names --apply --yes` on main root, item 2 = OpRename Raw\2026\old→new. execRename': fingerprint ok → JIntent (Barrier) → moveBoundNoReplace succeeds → `jAppend j Barrier (JDone …)` (Exec.hs:641) throws an InvalidArgument-class IOException (FlushFileBuffers hiccup; the 1.1.2 log says Hiccup applies to the main root too). execPlanRetry: `Left e`, judgeIO → root-id.json readable, type not deterministic/NoSuchThing → Hiccup; recover sleeps 5 s; `heal`. During those seconds the GUI's serve holds the main-root lock (Convert.hs:326 withRootLock for a convert batch, or ServeVault withVaultTxn = main root lock per ServeVault.hs:164) → runDoctorGate → withRootLock Nothing → diagnoseOnly → findings contain `R2 Warn` + `I10 Bad`; heal prints "补记 Done 1 条". settle: byProgress Nothing (eeProgress never fired for the item that threw), byJournal Nothing → item 2 re-run; the GUI batch has meanwhile finished so execPlan' takes the lock; execRename' finds old missing → CONFLICT, exit 1, catalog not updated, Intent still dangling (later `pm doctor` shows R2). The user was just told the Done was appended. DESIGN: REVIEW-LOG.md:599 registers as residual only "两场之间无锁窗口只对同 root 的另一个 pm 可见（常规 I10 竞争）"; nothing rules that heal may claim repairs it did not make, and DESIGN §6.7 says the busy-lock case must be "明说" (explicit). RemovableTests only pin the happy path (caseExecResume). Not refuted, but low: it needs a Hiccup-class exception exactly at the Done append plus a concurrent lock holder that releases before the retry, and the outcome is a misleading message + a CONFLICT/exit 1 with no data loss (the rename did land, doctor --repair fixes the journal).
verdict.corrected_summary: executePlanNow'.heal prints '自愈：pm doctor --repair 补记 Done N 条' from the count of C2/R2/Q-DONE-LOST Warn rows, but runDoctorGate silently degrades to diagnose-only (lock busy → I10 Bad, root not writable → I11 Bad) and those Warn rows exist regardless of whether applyRepairs ran, so the message can claim N repairs when zero JDone lines were written. For a landed OpRename whose Done append raised the hiccup, settle then finds no Done and the retry session reports CONFLICT '重命名源不存在' (exit 1, catalog not updated, Intent left dangling) although the rename succeeded. Message/cosmetic plus a confusing retry outcome in a rare coincidence; no data loss.
verdict.suggested_fix: In `heal` (Cli.hs:149-151) check for a degraded run before counting: if any finding has fRow ∈ ["I10","I11"] (or fSeverity Bad on those rows) print its fDetail as '· 自愈未执行：…' instead of the count; otherwise print the count as now. Optionally, when heal did not run, skip the retry and return Left so the user re-runs after doctor --repair.

confirmed.title: Write-ahead trash manifest record is never reconciled when the quarantine move fails or never runs (Q2), so pm trash list labels a never-quarantined file '已移出' and doctor's Q2 row does not clear the entry as DESIGN §6.4 specifies
confirmed.summary: execQuarantine' appends the manifest record (§6.3 step 1) before the Intent and before moveBoundNoReplace. If the rename fails (victim locked, read-only attribute) or the process dies before the move (Q2), the victim is untouched but the manifest permanently carries a record for a trashRel that never existed. trashView marks it present=False and runTrash' prints '已移出', whose comment defines it as 'purged or restored by rollback/undo'. DESIGN §6.4 row Q2 says '复核后清除该 manifest 条目', but Doctor only emits `Finding "Q2" Info`; nothing removes or marks the record (manifest is append-only), and re-running the plan appends a second record for the same trashRel.
confirmed.failure_scenario: Dedupe plan approves quarantining 成片\A\x.jpg while Lightroom holds x.jpg open. execQuarantine': appendManifest succeeds; JIntent; moveBoundNoReplace fails after 20 retries → JFailed → OFailed. Later `pm trash list` prints '  已移出  <pid>\成片\A\x.jpg  ← 成片\A\x.jpg (dedupe…)'. The file is still at its original place; nothing was ever in trash. || Crash between manifest append and the quarantine move (CpQuarAfterManifest/CpQuarAfterIntent). `pm doctor` → Q2 Info; user re-runs the plan (succeeds). `pm trash list` now shows two rows for the same trashRel: one "在库" and one "已移出" for an entry that was never in trash, and doctor never reconciles it.
confirmed.evidence: Exec.hs:685-706 `appendManifest root TrashRecord{…}` then `jAppend j Barrier (JIntent …)` then `mvE <- try (moveBoundNoReplace victimAbs trashAbs); case mvE of Left e -> … JFailed …; pure (OFailed …)`. Trash.hs:229 `registered = [(r, Map.member (trTrashRel r) fileSet) | r <- records]`. Commands.hs:300-302 `-- 「已移出」= 被 purge 或被复位/undo 移回原位` / `(if present then "在库" else "已移出")`. Manifest append-only (Trash.hs:113-119; Commands.hs:365-367 dedupes only for purge). Doctor.hs:490-496 `(PmStateMissing, True) -> … [Finding "Q2" Info …]` with empty fRepair; applyRepairs (655-695) never touches the manifest. DESIGN.md:363 Q2 row. KernelTests.hs:391-401 asserts only `("Q2", Info)` and victim exists.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: src/Pm/Exec.hs:687-706 confirmed — `appendManifest root TrashRecord{…}` runs first, then `jAppend j Barrier (JIntent …)`, then `mvE <- try (moveBoundNoReplace victimAbs trashAbs)`; on `Left e` only `JFailed` is appended and `OFailed` returned; nothing removes or marks the manifest record. Pm.Trash exports only appendManifest/readManifest (append-only via withPmStateAppend, Trash.hs:113-119); grep of Trash.hs/Doctor.hs/Commands.hs/Undo.hs shows no manifest rewrite anywhere. Doctor.hs:132-136 folds JFailed into non-pending, so the locked-file case produces no doctor row at all; the crash case (CpQuarAfterManifest/CpQuarAfterIntent) yields Doctor.hs:490-496 `Finding "Q2" Info … ""` with empty repair note, and applyRepairs (Doctor.hs:673-695) only appends journal Done for C2/R2/Q-DONE-LOST and deletes own tmp/derived. trashView (Trash.hs:224-235) sets present = Map.member trTrashRel fileSet, and Commands.hs:299-307 prints `if present then "在库" else "已移出"` with the comment at :301 defining 已移出 as purged or moved back by undo/rollback. Undo does not consume the manifest (Undo.hs mentions it only in a comment), so the stale record has no data-safety effect. REPRO: dedupe plan with OpQuarantine "成片/A/x.jpg" sha reason="dedupe…"; x.jpg held open without FILE_SHARE_DELETE. Exec: vsha matches → appendManifest writes {victim=成片/A/x.jpg, trashRel=<planId>/成片/A/x.jpg,…} → JIntent → moveBoundNoReplace throws (Win.hs:699-715 ioError on open/rename failure) → JFailed → OFailed. Later `pm trash list`: readManifest returns the record, listTrashFiles has no such file → registered=[(r,False)] → prints `  已移出  <planId>\成片\A\x.jpg  ← 成片\A\x.jpg  (dedupe…, plan …)` while x.jpg is still at its original place and never entered trash; `pm doctor` shows nothing. In the crash variant, doctor prints Q2 Info, the re-run succeeds and appends a second record for the same trashRel, so trash list shows one 在库 and one 已移出 row forever. DESIGN: docs/DESIGN.md:363 Q2 row says '未执行，victim 应仍在原位，复核后清除该 manifest 条目' — the doc agrees with the finder that doctor is supposed to reconcile the entry, and nothing does. DESIGN.md:530 claims 'C1-Q2 矩阵逐行有测试对应' but test/KernelTests.hs:391-401 only asserts ("Q2",Info) and victim exists, pinning nothing about the manifest. No REVIEW-LOG ruling drops the Q2 clearing; the only related rulings (DESIGN.md:255, :418, Commands.hs:365-367 P2.2) treat the manifest as append-only history and dedupe by trashRel in trash empty, which means the correct fix is probably a doc change plus a truthful label rather than manifest rewriting. Impact is confined to a misleading `pm trash list` label and a doc row that describes a repair that does not exist; trash empty filters on present=True so nothing is unlinked, and undo/apply never read the manifest — no data risk. Severity low as the finder rated.
verdict.corrected_summary: Quarantine writes its trash-manifest record before the move (§6.3 step 1). If the move then fails (JFailed) or the process dies before it (Q2), the record stays forever because the manifest is append-only and neither Exec, doctor nor --repair reconciles it. `pm trash list` renders such a never-quarantined entry as '已移出' (whose in-code meaning is 'purged or moved back by undo'), and DESIGN §6.4 Q2 promises '复核后清除该 manifest 条目' which no code implements; the move-failure case additionally leaves no doctor row at all. Cosmetic/doc drift only: trash empty ignores absent entries and undo does not read the manifest.
verdict.suggested_fix: Keep the manifest append-only (consistent with DESIGN.md:255/:418). (1) In docs/DESIGN.md §6.4 Q2 replace '复核后清除该 manifest 条目' with the real behaviour: the write-ahead record is left as history and shows as absent in `pm trash list`; add that a move failure with a Failed terminal leaves the same orphan record. (2) In Commands.hs runTrash' change the absent label from '已移出' to a neutral '不在 trash' (and adjust the comment at :301 to mention the never-landed case), optionally consulting the journal for a Done carrying that trashRel to distinguish '已移出' from '未入库（隔离未执行）'.

confirmed.title: A convert plan's derived source can be deleted by `pm doctor --repair` (DERIVED-STALE) while the plan still has an unresolved item that needs it
confirmed.summary: `convertPlan` emits several OpCopy items whose `opSrcAbs` all point at the same `.pm\derived\<sha>\<stem>.jpg`. As soon as one of them lands the catalog gains that sha, and `scanDerived` classifies the derived file as `DerivedStale`, which `doctor --repair` deletes. Any remaining NEEDS-DECISION item of the same plan then fails at execution with `源 stat 失败`.
confirmed.failure_scenario: `pm convert --also-album 成片/E/x.tif` where `相册\x.jpg` exists with different bytes: plan = [成片 item PENDING, 相册 item NEEDS-DECISION]. `pm apply` lands 成片\x.jpg. User runs `pm doctor --repair` → `.pm\derived\<S>\x.jpg` is deleted as DERIVED-STALE. User then `pm resolve <pid> --item 1 --keep src` and `pm apply` → `execCopy'` `statSnap` throws → OFailed 「源 stat 失败」.
confirmed.evidence: Convert.hs:240-247 all items share `dEntry d` as source; Convert.hs:12-13 header; Derived.hs:80-83 `if sha `Set.member` shas then DerivedStale`; Doctor.hs:230 `derivedDel = [f | (f, s) <- xs, s `elem` [DerivedStale, DerivedOrphan, DerivedTmp]]`; Exec.hs execCopy' `OFailed ("源 stat 失败: " …)`. DESIGN-P8 §20.2.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: Convert.hs:240-247 — for a 成片 source with --also-album, `mainDs` and `albumDs` both contain the same `Derived d`, so the 成片 item (via `albumPlanItems root 0 mrep`, Album.hs:119 `mkCopy root e d = OpCopy (root </> enPath e) …`) and the 相册 item (via `attachAlbumItems`, Album.hs:165 same `mkCopy`) share `opSrcAbs = root\.pm\derived\<S>\<stem>.jpg`. After `pm apply`, Cli.hs:283 `saveCatalog root (updateCatalog now results cat)` and ExecTypes.hs:104-116 insert the landed dst with `enSha = opSha op` (the derived jpg's sha S'). Derived.hs:78-83 then hashes the derived file, finds S' in `shas`, and returns `DerivedStale`; Doctor.hs:230 puts it in `derivedDel`, and Doctor.hs:704-713 `deleteBoundAt` unlinks it. scanDerived never consults `.pm/plans`. REPRO: 成片\E\x.tif, 相册\x.jpg exists with other bytes, catalog scanned. `pm convert --also-album 成片/E/x.tif`: mrep → arCopy (成片\E\x.jpg absent) → item 0 PENDING; arep → arConflict → Album.hs:164 item 1 `StNeedsDecision conflictWhy`, piGroup Nothing (groups empty, so item 0 stays ungrouped). `pm apply`: item 0 ODone, item 1 not executed; catalog now has S'. `pm doctor --repair`: derived x.jpg → DerivedStale → deleted (test caseDoctorDerived confirms STALE is deleted). `pm resolve <pid> --item 1 --keep src` (Apply.hs:279-330: ungrouped NEEDS-DECISION OpCopy accepted; dst exists → appends quarantine + copy with the same `op`). `pm apply`: quarantine lands, then Exec.hs:450-452 `statSnap (opSrcAbs op)` throws → `OFailed ("源 stat 失败: …")`; group failure auto-restores the quarantine (Exec.hs:252-260). Same outcome for `--keep both`, and for the documented coupled path (coupledWhy 「先裁决并完成成片那份，再 resolve --unskip 本项」) where the 成片 copy lands first and the album item is unskipped later; the automatic `heal = runDoctorWith dw root (DoctorOpts False True)` in Cli.hs:149-150 (drive-blip retry) runs the same repair including derivedDel. No data loss: user re-runs `pm convert --also-album` which re-derives (NameMissing → fresh) and emits a new plan (成片 item arAlready, 相册 item PENDING/DECIDE). DESIGN: DESIGN-P8 §20.2 defines STALE exactly as the code does (sha in any catalog entry = 已落位), so code matches the letter of the doc; but the same doc's DerivedPending intent (「派生了还没 apply」, `--repair … 留 pending`) and the §20.1 coupled workflow are jointly violated, and no REVIEW-LOG entry (m3 concerns dir-name vs file-sha only) or README limitation rules on a derived file still referenced by an unfinished plan item. Real but low: edge sequence (--also-album + one item landed + doctor --repair before the other is resolved), recoverable, only the failure message is confusing.
verdict.corrected_summary: With `pm convert --also-album` on a 成片 source, the 成片 and 相册 plan items share one derived source `.pm\derived\<S>\<stem>.jpg`. Once the 成片 copy lands and catalog writeback records its sha, `scanDerived` classifies the derived file as DERIVED-STALE (sha ∈ catalog) even though the plan's 相册 item (NEEDS-DECISION for an album conflict, or the documented coupled 「先完成成片再 --unskip」 case) still names it as `opSrcAbs`. Any `pm doctor --repair` in that window (manual, or the automatic heal in `execPlanRetry`) unlinks it; the later `pm apply` of that item fails with 「源 stat 失败」 (a `--keep src` quarantine is auto-restored). No data loss; recovery is re-running `pm convert`, but the user gets an unexplained stat failure instead of a pending/kept derived file.
verdict.suggested_fix: In `Pm.Doctor` (or `scanDerived` given an extra argument), collect `opSrcAbs` of every `OpCopy` item whose status is `StPending` or `StNeedsDecision` across `listPlans root`, and for any derived file in that set report `DERIVED-PENDING` (「计划 <pid> 仍引用」) and exclude it from `derivedDel` instead of STALE/ORPHAN; keep the existing rule for everything else.

confirmed.title: Convert reuses albumPlanItems for 成片-target conflicts, so the NEEDS-DECISION reason says 「相册已有同名但内容不同」 for a 成片 conflict
confirmed.summary: `convertPlan` builds the 成片-layer items with `albumPlanItems root 0 mrep`; that helper hard-codes `conflictWhy = "相册已有同名但内容不同（I5）→ pm resolve …"` for every `arConflict`, but in `mrep` the conflicting target is `成片\<event>\<stem>.jpg`.
confirmed.failure_scenario: `成片\E2\clash.png` is converted while `成片\E2\clash.jpg` exists with other bytes (the ConvertTests caseE2E fixture). The saved plan item for dst `成片\E2\clash.jpg` is `DECIDE` with why-text 「相册已有同名但内容不同…」; the user is told the album has the conflicting file.
confirmed.evidence: Convert.hs:241-242 `mrep = classifyInto …; base = albumPlanItems root 0 mrep`; Album.hs:128 `conflicts = [(mkCopy root e d, StNeedsDecision conflictWhy) | …]`; Album.hs:115 `conflictWhy = "相册已有同名但内容不同（I5）…"`. Convert.hs:251 sink note is generic.

verdict.reasoning: CODE: Convert.hs:241-242 `mrep = classifyInto (\p -> … mainDst) cat (map dEntry mainDs); base = albumPlanItems root 0 mrep` — here `dstOf` yields `成片\<event>\<stem>.jpg` (line 240). Album.hs:123-128 `albumPlanItems` hard-codes `conflicts = [(mkCopy root e d, StNeedsDecision conflictWhy) | (e, d) <- arConflict rep]` with Album.hs:115 `conflictWhy = "相册已有同名但内容不同（I5）→ pm resolve --keep src|dst|both"`. Nothing in Convert rewrites the status text. REPRO (the ConvertTests caseE2E fixture, test/ConvertTests.hs:187-197): catalog holds 成片\E2\clash.jpg ("OTHER"), `pm convert --also-album 成片/E2/clash.png`. mrep: `judged` for the derived entry finds `成片\E2\clash.jpg` in `catByFold` with a different sha → `Just False` → arConflict. base item 0 = OpCopy derived→成片\E2\clash.jpg, `StNeedsDecision "相册已有同名但内容不同（I5）→ pm resolve …"`, saved verbatim to the plan JSON (`why` field, Plan.hs:69) and shown in `renderPlan` as DECIDE. The conflicting file is in 成片\E2, not 相册; the album item (Album.hs:162, coupledWhy) is the only one that mentions 成片. The sink note at Convert.hs:251 is generic and does not correct it. The test only asserts `StNeedsDecision _` (line 194), so it does not pin the text. DESIGN: DESIGN-P8 §20.1 says the judgement is 「同一份代码」 (classifyInto) but says nothing about reusing the album wording; no REVIEW-LOG ruling or README limitation covers it. Real but cosmetic: the recommended action (`pm resolve --keep src|dst|both`) is still correct and the rendered plan line shows the real dst path, so the user is misled only about which layer holds the clashing file.
verdict.corrected_summary: `convertPlan` builds the 成片-layer items with `albumPlanItems`, whose conflict status text is fixed to 「相册已有同名但内容不同（I5）→ pm resolve --keep src|dst|both」. For a convert whose derived jpg clashes with an existing `成片\<event>\<stem>.jpg` (e.g. the caseE2E clash.png/clash.jpg fixture) the saved plan item therefore says the album has the conflicting file although the conflict is in the 成片 event folder. The suggested resolve action is still right; only the location wording is wrong.
verdict.suggested_fix: Give `albumPlanItems` (or a small wrapper used by Convert) the why-text as a parameter, and have `convertPlan` pass e.g. 「成片同事件夹已有同名但内容不同（I5）→ pm resolve --keep src|dst|both」 for `mrep`; alternatively post-map `base` in `convertPlan` replacing `StNeedsDecision conflictWhy` with the 成片-specific text.

confirmed.summary: i7Findings explains an album photo with no same-sha twin in 成片 by any journal Copy Intent whose dst is that album path and whose src is outside the root. On a backup root every entry was landed by a `pm backup` Copy whose srcAbs is the main library path, so every album file on the backup drive is 'explained' as inbox-origin.

confirmed.evidence: src/Pm/Doctor.hs:288-301 `srcsFor e = [opSrcAbs op | JIntent _ op@OpCopy {} _ <- entries, …]`; `fromInbox e = elem (Just False) <$> mapM (pathAtOrUnder root) (srcsFor e)`. src/Pm/Diff.hs:89-91 backup OpCopy with src on the main root. docs/DESIGN-COMMANDS.md §『doctor 的 I7 判定侧』. app/Main.hs run (CmdDoctor …) → pickRoot SelBackup.
